# Setup

Loads packages, helper functions and colour palettes, and reads the processed MPX objects from both batches.

## Libraries, parameters, and functions

Sources all helper scripts in scripts/R/, loads the required packages and defines the colour palettes used across the figures.

```{r general_def, message=FALSE}
#| code-fold: true
set.seed(1)
here::i_am("mpx_2/scripts/02_analysis_b1b2.qmd")

png_res <- 300

# General rule for the minimum number of cells of a cell type in a sample: 15 where
# no sensitive test is run (marker selection, averages shown in heatmaps and
# networks, cell-level tests). The unpaired pseudobulk limma tests of Fig 5 and 6
# use a higher value (pseudobulk_min_cells = 30, set in chunk fig-5-daa-pseudobulk).
# Plots made per donor or per sample show all samples and need no cutoff.
min_cells_default <- 15
```

```{r message=FALSE}
#| code-fold: true
#| output: false

fn_sources <- list.files(
  here::here("mpx_2/scripts", "R"),
  pattern = "*.R$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

sapply(fn_sources, source, .GlobalEnv)
```

```{r message=FALSE}
#| code-fold: true
load_packages(
  c(
    "dplyr",
    "tidyr",
    "ggplot2",
    "patchwork",
    "pixelatorR",
    "Seurat",
    "readr",
    "ggrepel",
    "harmony",
    "here",
    "stringr",
    "tibble",
    "ComplexHeatmap",

  )
)

library(ggbeeswarm)
library(quartabs)

library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)

# install.packages("ggalluvial")
library(ggalluvial)

conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
```

## Read data

We will continue to work from the data object that we created in the first processing script. This includes all the necessary information we need to continue the analysis here.

Here we read the processed batch 2 object and the batch 1 object from the mpx project. 
Platelets (and discarded cells in batch 1) are removed. 
Batch 1 donor IDs and cell type names are harmonised to the batch 2 naming.

```{r}
data_t0t1_b1 <- readRDS(here(
  "mpx",
  "rdata",
  "robj_suzuki_cart_processed_data_all.rds"
)) |>
  subset(timepoint %in% c("t0", "t1"))

data_donorA <- readRDS(here(
  "mpx",
  "rdata",
  "robj_suzuki_cart_processed_data_all.rds"
)) |>
  subset(donor %in% c("donor_32"))

data_t0t1_b2 <- readRDS(here(
  "mpx_2",
  "rdata",
  "robj_suzuki_cart_processed_data_mpx_b2_all.rds"
))

data_t0_b1b2 <- readRDS(here(
  "mpx_2",
  "rdata",
  "robj_suzuki_cart_processed_data_b1b2_t0.rds"
))
```

Update filtering of data to exclude platelets and cells annotated as "discard" (batch 1) or "other" (batch 2).

```{r}
# Prepare b1 data for merge
data_t0t1_b1 <- data_t0t1_b1 |>
  subset(celltype != "Platelets") |>
  subset(celltype != "discard") |>
  subset(celltype != "other")

data_t0t1_b1$batch <- "batch_1"

data_t0t1_b1@meta.data <- data_t0t1_b1@meta.data |>
  mutate(
    donor = case_when(
      donor == 'donor_32' ~ 'donorA',
      donor == 'donor_44' ~ 'donorB',
      donor == 'donor_50' ~ 'donorC',
      TRUE ~ donor
    )
  )

# Update celltype annotation for FMC63- cells in b1
data_t0t1_b1@meta.data <- data_t0t1_b1@meta.data |>
  mutate(
    celltype = case_when(
      celltype == 'CD4 T' ~ 'CD4 T FMC63-',
      celltype == 'CD8 T' ~ 'CD8 T FMC63-',
      TRUE ~ celltype
    )
  )

# Prepare b2 data for merge
data_t0t1_b2 <- data_t0t1_b2 |>
  subset(celltype != "Platelets") |>
  subset(celltype != "other") # TEST: see if it makes a difference to remove the "other" cells

data_t0t1_b2$batch <- "batch_2"

# Make formatting edits to align datasets
```

```{r}
# Make same formatting for T0 data
data_t0_b1b2 <- data_t0_b1b2 |>
  subset(celltype != "other")
```

## Merge data

Combines both batches into a single Seurat object, data_t0t1_b1b2, with joined layers.

```{r}
data_t0t1_b1b2 <- merge(
  data_t0t1_b1,
  y = data_t0t1_b2,
) |>
  SeuratObject::JoinLayers()

# Update metadata and make formatting edits to align datasets
data_t0t1_b1b2$sample_alias <- paste0(
  data_t0t1_b1b2$donor,
  "_",
  data_t0t1_b1b2$timepoint
)

data_t0t1_b1b2$celltype[data_t0t1_b1b2$celltype == "Other T"] <- "T other"
```

# Reprocessing merged data

Re-runs normalisation, dimensionality reduction and integration on the merged object, since the per-batch embeddings aren't comparable.

## Normalize and scale

CLR-normalises the merged counts and scales the data for PCA.

```{r}
data_t0t1_b1b2 <- data_t0t1_b1b2 |>
  NormalizeMPX(method = "clr") |>
  ScaleData()
```


## PCA & UMAP

Runs PCA, chooses the number of PCs from the elbow plot (15) and computes an uncorrected UMAP, shown by batch, donor, timepoint and cell type.

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
data_t0t1_b1b2 <- data_t0t1_b1b2 |>
  RunPCA()

ElbowPlot(data_t0t1_b1b2, ndims = 30)
```

```{r}
n_dims <- 15
data_t0t1_b1b2 <- data_t0t1_b1b2 |>
  RunUMAP(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:n_dims, reduction.name = "umap.pca")
```

```{r fig.width=15, fig.height=5}
pt_size <- 0.1
p1 <- DimPlot(
  object = data_t0t1_b1b2,
  reduction = "umap.pca",
  group.by = "batch",
  # cols = pal_samples,
  pt.size = pt_size
) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") &
  coord_fixed()

p2 <- DimPlot(
  object = data_t0t1_b1b2,
  reduction = "umap.pca",
  group.by = "donor",
  cols = pal_donor,
  pt.size = pt_size
) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") &
  coord_fixed()

p3 <- DimPlot(
  object = data_t0t1_b1b2,
  reduction = "umap.pca",
  group.by = "timepoint",
  cols = pal_time,
  pt.size = pt_size
) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") &
  coord_fixed()

p4 <- DimPlot(
  object = data_t0t1_b1b2,
  reduction = "umap.pca",
  group.by = "celltype",
  cols = cell_type_palette_fmc,
  pt.size = pt_size
) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") &
  coord_fixed()

p <- (p1 | p2 | p3 | p4)
p
export_plot(
  filename = here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "processed",
    "pca_umap_dimplot"
  ),
  plot = p,
  width = 20,
  height = 5
)
```


### Harmony

Integrates the PCs with Harmony (by sample and batch) and computes a corrected UMAP, followed by FMC63 / T cell marker UMAPs and density-scatter QC plots.

```{r}
integrate_by <- c("sample", "batch") # TEST: exclude 'type'

data_t0t1_b1b2 <- data_t0t1_b1b2 |>
  RunHarmony(
    group.by.vars = integrate_by,
    plot_convergence = FALSE
  ) |>
  RunUMAP(
    reduction = "harmony",
    dims = 1:n_dims,
    reduction.name = "umap.harmony"
  )
```

## 3C: Density plots

```{r}
ds_cd4 <- DensityScatterPlot(
  data_t0_b1b2 |> subset(type == "CAR-T_product" & celltype_broad == "CD4 T"),
  marker1 = "CD4",
  marker2 = "FMC63",
  plot_gate = tibble(xmin = 0.1, xmax = 5, ymin = 1.5, ymax = 5.5),
  gate_type = "rectangle",
  facet_vars = "celltype_broad",
  annotation_params = list(size = 4)
) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(celltype_broad)) +
  lims(x = c(0, 5), y = c(-5, 6)) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "white"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#224792", color = "#224792")
  )


ds_cd8 <- DensityScatterPlot(
  data_t0_b1b2 |> subset(type == "CAR-T_product" & celltype_broad == "CD8 T"),
  marker1 = "CD8",
  marker2 = "FMC63",
  plot_gate = tibble(xmin = 1, xmax = 5, ymin = 1.5, ymax = 5.5),
  gate_type = "rectangle",
  facet_vars = "celltype_broad",
  annotation_params = list(size = 4),
) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(celltype_broad)) +
  lims(x = c(0, 5), y = c(-5, 6)) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "white"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#A75FC3", color = "#A75FC3")
  )


export_plot(
  filename = here("mpx_2", "results", "b1b2_t0t1", "revised_figs", "3C"), # Manuscript: Main Figure 3C
  plot = wrap_plots(ds_cd4, ds_cd8, ncol = 2),
  width = 5 * 1.5,
  height = 3 * 1.5
)
```

## 3D: Cell fractions

### CAR T product (T0) only

Only for selected cell types.
```{r}
data_t0_b1b2[[]] |>
  select(donor, celltype, timepoint) |>
  filter(
    celltype %in%
      c(
        "CD4 T FMC63-",
        "CD4 T FMC63+",
        "CD8 T FMC63-",
        "CD8 T FMC63+",
        "NK",
        "T other"
      )
  ) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    .by = c(donor, celltype, timepoint)
  ) |>
  arrange(donor, celltype) |>
  readr::write_csv(here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "cell_counts_t0.csv"
  ))

cell_fraction_plot <- pixelatorR::CellCountPlot(
  data_t0_b1b2 |>
    subset(timepoint == "t0"),
  group_by = "donor",
  color_by = "celltype",
  stack = TRUE,
  as_frequency = TRUE
)

cell_fraction_data <- cell_fraction_plot$data |>
  mutate(
    frequency = frequency / 100,
  )

final_plot <- ggplot(
  cell_fraction_data |>
    mutate(donor = gsub("donor", "", donor)),
  aes(x = donor, y = frequency, fill = celltype)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_type_palette_fmc) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  ) +
  labs(x = "Donor", y = "Frequency", fill = NULL)

final_plot

export_plot(
  filename = here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "3D_cell_props" # Manuscript: Main Figure 3D (left)
  ),
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 5,
  height = 4
)
```

Alternative plot:

```{r}
# Swarm plot of the same t0 cell fractions: one point per donor, CD4/CD8 T only
# Share of FMC63+ (CAR+) cells among all CD4 T and all CD8 T cells, per donor (t0)
tcell_types <- c("CD4 T FMC63-", "CD4 T FMC63+", "CD8 T FMC63-", "CD8 T FMC63+")

fmc63_fraction_data <- cell_fraction_data |>
  filter(celltype %in% tcell_types) |>
  # A donor with no cells of a subtype has no row; add it as a 0 count
  tidyr::complete(donor, celltype = tcell_types, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
  mutate(
    lineage = sub(" FMC63[+-]$", "", celltype),
    fmc63_status = sub("^.* ", "", celltype)
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_fmc63_pos = sum(n[fmc63_status == "FMC63+"]),
    n_total = sum(n),
    .by = c(donor, lineage)
  ) |>
  # A donor with no CD4 (or CD8) T cells at all has no defined fraction
  filter(n_total > 0) |>
  mutate(
    fmc63_frequency = n_fmc63_pos / n_total,
    lineage = factor(lineage, levels = c("CD4 T", "CD8 T"))
  )

fmc63_swarm_plot <- ggplot(
  fmc63_fraction_data,
  aes(x = lineage, y = fmc63_frequency)
) +
  # Median per lineage
  # stat_summary(
  #   fun = median,
  #   geom = "crossbar",
  #   width = 0.5,
  #   linewidth = 0.3,
  #   color = "grey40"
  # ) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(
    aes(fill = donor),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3,
    cex = 3,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.25,
    dodge.width = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_donor, labels = \(x) gsub("donor", "", x)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0, 1), linewidth = 0.25) +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio = 1.5,
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "FMC63+ cells (% of lineage)",
    title = "Cell proportions at T0",
    fill = "Donor"
  )
fmc63_swarm_plot

export_plot(
  filename = here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "3D_fmc63_fraction_swarm" # Manuscript: Main Figure 3D (right)
  ),
  plot = fmc63_swarm_plot,
  width = 3,
  height = 4
)
```

```{r}
# Summarize abundace data
plot_data <- plot_data_clr |>

    cols = all_of(markers_to_plot),
    names_to = "marker",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) |>

    mean_clr = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

cell_types <- plot_data$celltype |> unique()
# cell_select <- cells_plot[1]
for (cell_select in cell_types) {
  # Prepare heatmap data
  hm_data <-
    plot_data |>
    filter(celltype == cell_select) |>
    group_by(sample_alias, marker) |>
    select(marker, sample_alias, mean_clr) |>
    # Pivot to wide format for heatmap
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = sample_alias,
      values_from = mean_clr,
      values_fill = 0
    ) |>
    column_to_rownames("marker") |>
    t() |>
    as.matrix()

  # Plot heatmap
  effect_vals <- as.numeric(hm_data)
  effect_quantiles <- quantile(effect_vals, probs = c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
  max_abs_effect <- max(abs(effect_quantiles))
  breaks_range <- seq(0, max_abs_effect, length.out = 101)
  sample_order <- intersect(sample_order, rownames(hm_data))

  lims <- c(0, 5)
  col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
    seq(lims[1], lims[2], length.out = 100),
    retro_palette(100)
  )

  hm <-
    hm_data[sample_order, markers_to_plot] |>
    pheatmap(
      color = col_fun,
      border_color = "white",
      cellwidth = 10,
      cellheight = 10,

      cluster_cols = F,

    )),

    width = 8,
    height = 4
  )
}
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
fetch_abundance <- function(ct_label, min_cells = min_cells_per_sample) {
  abundance <- data_t0_b1b2 %>%
    subset(celltype == ct_label & sample %in% samples_plot) |>
    FetchData(
      vars = c("patient", markers_selected),
      assay = "mpxCells",
      layer = "data"
    ) %>%
    group_by(patient) %>%
    summarise(
      n_cells = n(),
      across(all_of(markers_selected), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Report and drop samples with too few cells of this type
  too_few <- abundance |> filter(n_cells < min_cells)
  if (nrow(too_few) > 0) {
    message(
      ct_label,
      ": excluded (fewer than ",
      min_cells,
      " cells): ",
      paste0(too_few$patient, " (", too_few$n_cells, ")", collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  abundance |>
    filter(n_cells >= min_cells) |>
    select(-n_cells) |>
    mutate(celltype = ct_label)
}

abundance_combined <- bind_rows(
  fetch_abundance(ct_1),
  fetch_abundance(ct_2)
)

mat <- abundance_combined[, c("patient", "celltype", markers_selected)] |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  unite("row_id", patient, celltype, sep = " | ", remove = TRUE) |>
  column_to_rownames("row_id") |>
  as.matrix()

ct_split <- abundance_combined$celltype
patient_split <- abundance_combined$patient

ct_colors <- c(ct_1 = "#4A0180", ct_2 = "#AD5BCD")
names(ct_colors) <- c(ct_1, ct_2)

  `Cell type` = ct_split,

    `Patient` = pal_donor

)

lims <- c(0, 5)

  seq(lims[1], lims[2], length.out = 100),
  retro_palette(100)
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "Abundance\n(CLR)",
  col = col_fun,
  row_split = ct_split,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,

)

pdf(

# Mean difference in CLR across donors: CD8 T FMC63+ minus CD8 T FMC63-.
# The difference is computed within each donor first (paired), then averaged,
# using only donors with at least min_cells_per_sample cells of both types.
abundance_diff_per_donor <- abundance_combined |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    all_of(markers_selected),
    names_to = "marker",
    values_to = "mean_clr"
  ) |>

  mutate(diff_clr = .data[[ct_1]] - .data[[ct_2]])

n_donors_diff <- n_distinct(abundance_diff_per_donor$patient)

abundance_diff_mean <- abundance_diff_per_donor |>
  summarise(
    mean_diff_clr = mean(diff_clr),

# Table behind the heatmap, including the spread across donors

mat_diff <- abundance_diff_mean |>
  select(marker, mean_diff_clr) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = mean_diff_clr) |>

rownames(mat_diff) <- paste0("Mean across donors (n=", n_donors_diff, ")")

# Symmetric colour scale around 0

  c(-diff_lim, 0, diff_lim),
  pal_org_bl

ht_diff <- Heatmap(
  mat_diff,
  name = "Mean CLR\ndifference\n(FMC63+ - FMC63-)",

  row_names_side = "left",

  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),

  # 1 snpc = 8 in): 8 in wide, rows as tall as one abundance heatmap row
  width = unit(8, "in"),
  height = unit(8 * 0.3 / nrow(mat), "in"),
  column_title = paste0(

    ct_1,
    " vs ",

    " (t0)"
  ),
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold")
)

draw(ht_diff)

pdf(
  here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results/b1b2_t0t1/revised_figs/3G_marker_heatmap_abundance_clr_diff_mean.pdf"
  ),
  width = 12,
  height = 3
)
draw(ht_diff)
dev.off()

png(

  ),
  width = 16,
  height = 3,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)
draw(ht_diff)
dev.off()


# Stacked heatmap
# Difference matrix in the SAME column order as mat (heatmaps in a vertical list
# are aligned by position; the main heatmap's clustering reorders both)
mat_diff_stack <- mat_diff[, colnames(mat), drop = FALSE]
cell_h <- unit(8 * 0.3 / nrow(mat), "in") # row height used by the abundance heatmap

ht_top <- Heatmap(
```

```{r}
data_cell_plot_gi <- data_cell_plot
```

# Figure 4

## 4A: Polarity score in FMC63+ CD8+ T cells

```{r}
#| label: fmc63-polarity_pos

# Abundance-based marker pre-filtering (as in the raw colocalization heatmaps):
# a marker is kept if its mean CLR is at or above pol_min_mean_clr in every t0 sample
# with >= pol_min_cells cells of this cell type
pol_celltype <- "CD8 T FMC63+"
pol_min_cells <- min_cells_default
pol_min_mean_clr <- 0.5

pol_markers <- pseudobulk_mean_clr(
  subset(data_t0_b1b2, timepoint == "t0" & celltype == pol_celltype),
  group_col = "celltype",
  sample_col = "sample_alias",
  contrast_column = "timepoint",
  min_cells = pol_min_cells
)$sample_means |>
  summarise(min_sample_mean_clr = min(mean_clr), .by = marker) |>
  filter(min_sample_mean_clr >= pol_min_mean_clr) |>
  pull(marker)
message(pol_celltype, ": ", length(pol_markers), " markers selected")

data_t0_b1b2$component <- rownames(data_t0_b1b2@meta.data)
pol_scores <- PolarizationScores(data_t0_b1b2) |>
  left_join(
    data_t0_b1b2@meta.data |>
      select(component, celltype, donor, timepoint),
    by = "component"
  ) |>
  # Previously: filter(marker %in% selected_markers[["CD8 T FMC63+"]])
  filter(marker %in% pol_markers) |>
  group_by(celltype, donor, marker, timepoint) |>
  summarise(morans_z = mean(morans_z, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

pol_mat <- pol_scores |>
  filter(celltype == "CD8 T FMC63+", timepoint == "t0") |>
  unite("row_id", donor, sep = " | ") |>
  select(row_id, marker, morans_z) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = morans_z) |>
  column_to_rownames("row_id") |>
  as.matrix()

pol_mat[is.na(pol_mat)] <- 0

row_meta <- pol_scores |>
  select(donor) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(donor)

pol_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  seq(0, 6, length.out = 100),
  cherry_gradient(100)
)

pol_row_ann <- rowAnnotation(
  `Donor` = row_meta$donor,
  col = list(
    `Donor` = pal_donor
  ),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  annotation_name_side = "top",
  show_legend = TRUE
)

ht_pol <- Heatmap(
  pol_mat,
  name = "Polarity\n(Moran's Z)",
```

## 4C: Colocalization heatmap of all FMC63+ CD8+ T cells

### Cell-level heatmap

```{r}
data_t0_b1b2$component <- NULL

colocscores_dat <- ColocalizationScores(
  data_t0_b1b2,
  meta_data_columns = c(
    "sample_alias",
    "sample",
    "donor",
    "celltype",
    "timepoint"
  )
)

colocscores_dat$celltype_timepoint <- paste0(
  colocscores_dat$celltype,
  "_",
  colocscores_dat$timepoint
)

colocscores_summarized <- SummarizeProximityScores(
  colocscores_dat |>
    rename(join_count_z = pearson_z),
  group_vars = c("sample_alias", "donor", "celltype", "timepoint"),
  proximity_metric = "join_count_z",
  summary_stat = "mean",
  include_missing_obs = T
) |>
  rename(mean_pearson_z = mean_join_count_z)
```


```{r}
#| label: fig4_c_fmc63_colocalization_heatmap

samples_plot <- colocscores_summarized |>
  filter(timepoint == "t0") |>
  pull(donor) |>
  unique()
coloc_dat_plot <- list()

# Marker pre-filtering as in colocalization_raw_heatmap_per_cell_type_per_timepoint,
# based on FMC63+ CD8 T cells only (FMC63- plot follows the FMC63+ markers):
# a marker is kept if its mean CLR is at or above coloc_min_mean_clr in every sample
# with >= coloc_min_cells cells
coloc_min_cells <- min_cells_default
coloc_min_mean_clr <- 0.5

# Previous marker selection (FilterMarkers-based), replaced by the CLR filter below:
# cd8t_markers <- unique(unlist(selected_markers[c(3, 4)]))

pb_clr_4c <- pseudobulk_mean_clr(
  subset(data_t0_b1b2, timepoint == "t0" & celltype == "CD8 T FMC63+"),
  group_col = "celltype",
  sample_col = "sample_alias",
  contrast_column = "timepoint",
  min_cells = coloc_min_cells
)
pb_clr_4c$excluded # sample x cell type combinations below coloc_min_cells

markers_pos <- pb_clr_4c$sample_means |>
  summarise(min_sample_mean_clr = min(mean_clr), .by = marker) |>
  filter(min_sample_mean_clr >= coloc_min_mean_clr) |>
  pull(marker)
stopifnot(length(markers_pos) >= 2)
message("FMC63+ CD8 T: ", length(markers_pos), " markers selected")

# Donors with >= coloc_min_cells cells per cell type (applied to both plots)
donors_min_cells <- data_t0_b1b2@meta.data |>
  filter(timepoint == "t0") |>
  count(donor, celltype, name = "n_cells") |>
  filter(n_cells >= coloc_min_cells)

#' Prep data
samples_neg <- donors_min_cells |>
  filter(celltype == "CD8 T FMC63-", donor %in% samples_plot) |>
  pull(donor)
coloc_dat_plot[["CD8 T FMC63-"]] <- lapply(
  samples_neg,
  function(sample_select) {
    scores_sample <- colocscores_summarized |>
      filter(timepoint == "t0") |>
      filter(marker_1 %in% markers_pos, marker_2 %in% markers_pos) |>
      filter(celltype == "CD8 T FMC63-", donor == sample_select) |>
      select(donor, marker_1, marker_2, mean_pearson_z)
    return(scores_sample)
  }
) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = donor, values_from = mean_pearson_z) |>
  mutate(
    mean_coloc_score = rowMeans(across(all_of(samples_neg)), na.rm = TRUE),
    size_constant = 1
  )

samples_pos <- donors_min_cells |>
  filter(celltype == "CD8 T FMC63+", donor %in% samples_plot) |>
  pull(donor)
coloc_dat_plot[["CD8 T FMC63+"]] <- lapply(
  samples_pos,
  function(sample_select) {
    scores_sample <- colocscores_summarized |>
      filter(timepoint == "t0") |>
      filter(marker_1 %in% markers_pos, marker_2 %in% markers_pos) |>
      filter(celltype == "CD8 T FMC63+", donor == sample_select) |>
      select(donor, marker_1, marker_2, mean_pearson_z)
    return(scores_sample)
  }
) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = donor, values_from = mean_pearson_z) |>
  mutate(
    mean_coloc_score = rowMeans(across(all_of(samples_pos)), na.rm = TRUE),
    size_constant = 1
  )

coloc_caption <- glue::glue(
  "Only including samples with >= {coloc_min_cells} cells.
  Markers selected based on FMC63+ abundance CLR >= {coloc_min_mean_clr}."
)

#' Plot for CAR+ T cells (reference: clustered, defines marker order)
p2 <- ColocalizationHeatmap_custom(
  coloc_dat_plot[["CD8 T FMC63+"]],
  value_col = "mean_coloc_score",
  size_col = "size_constant",
  type = "dots",
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  legend_range = c(-5, 5),
  size_range = c(1, 4.5)
) &
  labs(
    title = "FMC63+ CD8 T cells",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "Mean\npearson Z\n(of donor mean)",
    caption = coloc_caption
  ) &
  # scale_y_discrete(position = "right", limits = rev(m_order)) & # Add this if marker labels should be on right side
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
  ) &
  guides(size = "none")

m_order <- ggplot2::ggplot_build(p2)$layout$panel_params[[1]]$x$get_labels()

#' Plot for CAR- T cells (same markers and marker order as FMC63+)
p1 <- ColocalizationHeatmap_custom(
  coloc_dat_plot[["CD8 T FMC63-"]],
  value_col = "mean_coloc_score",
  size_col = "size_constant",
  marker_order = m_order,
  cluster_rows = F,
  cluster_cols = F,
  type = "dots",
  legend_range = c(-5, 5),
  size_range = c(1, 4.5)
) &
  labs(
    title = "FMC63- CD8 T cells",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "Mean\npearson Z\n(of donor mean)",
    caption = coloc_caption
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "none") &
  guides(size = "none")

export_plot(
  here("mpx_2", "results", "b1b2_t0t1", "revised_figs", "4C_cd8_fmc63_pos_t0"),
  p1 | p2,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)
```

## 4D alt: FMC63 network summarized

```{r}
#| label: fig4_d_fmc63_network_averaged

#' FMC63 network averaged across donors (t0, CD8 T FMC63+).
#' A partner is kept only if it is present in every donor and its
#' mean_pearson_z has the same sign in every donor. Edges show the mean
#' across donors. One network for positive, one for negative colocalization.

tp_select <- "t0"
ct_select <- "CD8 T FMC63+"

# Abundance-based marker pre-filtering (as in the raw colocalization heatmaps):
# a marker is kept if its mean CLR is at or above net_min_mean_clr in every t0 sample
# with >= net_min_cells cells of this cell type
net_min_cells <- min_cells_default
net_min_mean_clr <- 0.5

# Previously: markers_plot <- c("FMC63", markers_selected), with markers_selected
# from unique(unlist(selected_markers[c(3, 4)]))
markers_selected_clr <- pseudobulk_mean_clr(
  subset(data_t0_b1b2, timepoint == tp_select & celltype == ct_select),
  group_col = "celltype",
  sample_col = "sample_alias",
  contrast_column = "timepoint",
  min_cells = net_min_cells
)$sample_means |>
  summarise(min_sample_mean_clr = min(mean_clr), .by = marker) |>
  filter(min_sample_mean_clr >= net_min_mean_clr) |>
  pull(marker)
message(ct_select, ": ", length(markers_selected_clr), " markers selected")

markers_plot <- base::union("FMC63", markers_selected_clr)
# Same magnitude threshold as the per-donor networks above; set to 0 to keep
# every partner with a consistent sign
min_abs_z <- 0.1 # 0.25
custom_limits <- c(-6, 6)

df_fmc63_per_donor <- colocscores_summarized |>
  filter(celltype == ct_select, timepoint == tp_select) |>
  filter(marker_1 == "FMC63" | marker_2 == "FMC63", marker_1 != marker_2) |>
  mutate(
    to = ifelse(marker_1 == "FMC63", marker_2, marker_1),
    from = "FMC63"
  ) |>
  filter(to %in% markers_plot) |>
  select(from, to, donor, mean_pearson_z)

n_donors_net <- n_distinct(df_fmc63_per_donor$donor)

df_fmc63_avg <- df_fmc63_per_donor |>
  summarise(
    n_donors = n_distinct(donor),
    all_pos = all(mean_pearson_z > min_abs_z),
    all_neg = all(mean_pearson_z < -min_abs_z),
    mean_z = mean(mean_pearson_z),
    sd_z = sd(mean_pearson_z),
    .by = c(from, to)
  ) |>
  # Present in every donor, with the same direction in every donor
  filter(n_donors == n_donors_net, all_pos | all_neg) |>
  mutate(
    direction = ifelse(all_pos, "positive", "negative"),
    mean_z_limit = pmin(pmax(mean_z, custom_limits[1]), custom_limits[2])
  )

readr::write_csv(
  df_fmc63_avg,
  here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "4D_fmc63_network_averaged.csv"
  )
)

plot_avg_network <- function(edges, title) {
  # No partner passed the filters: return a labelled empty panel instead of
  # failing (a graph without edges has no FMC63 node to centre on)
  if (nrow(edges) == 0) {
    message(title, ": no partners pass the filters, drawing an empty panel")
    return(
      ggplot() +
        annotate(
          "text",
          x = 0,
          y = 0,
          label = "No partners with the same sign in all donors"
        ) +
        labs(title = title) +
        theme_void() +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))
    )
  }

  graph <- tidygraph::as_tbl_graph(
    edges |> select(from, to, mean_z, mean_z_limit)
  )
  center_idx <- which(igraph::V(graph)$name == "FMC63")
  ggraph(graph, layout = "star", center = center_idx) +
    # The star layout puts partners on a unit circle. Fixed limits keep the
    # panel square when all nodes fall on one line (1-2 partners), which would
    # otherwise give a zero-height panel that breaks the repelled labels
    expand_limits(x = c(-1.3, 1.3), y = c(-1.3, 1.3)) +
    geom_edge_link(aes(color = mean_z_limit), width = 3) +
    geom_node_label(
      aes(label = name, filter = name == "FMC63"),
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 4,
      fill = "#FEFCDA",
      label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines")
    ) +
    # geom_node_label(
    #   aes(label = name, filter = name != "FMC63")
    #   size = 1,
    #   fill = "#FEFCDA",
    #   label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines")
    # ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = name, filter = name != "FMC63"),
      size = 4,
      repel = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_edge_color_gradientn(
      colours = c("#233C62", "white", "#931b58"),
      limits = custom_limits,
      name = "Mean\npearson_z"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
    ) +
    coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9)
    )
}

edges_pos <- df_fmc63_avg |> filter(direction == "positive")
edges_neg <- df_fmc63_avg |> filter(direction == "negative")

fmc63_network_avg_pos <- plot_avg_network(
  edges_pos,
  "FMC63 colocalization network"
)
fmc63_network_avg_neg <- plot_avg_network(
  edges_neg,
  "FMC63 segregation network"
)

avg_caption <- glue::glue(
  "{ct_select}, {tp_select}; mean of {n_donors_net} donors. Markers selected based on \\
  abundance CLR >= {net_min_mean_clr} in every sample with >= {net_min_cells} cells \\
  ({length(markers_selected_clr)} markers).
  Partners shown have the same sign and \\
  |Pearson Z| > {min_abs_z} in all donors."
)

p <- (fmc63_network_avg_pos | fmc63_network_avg_neg) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    caption = avg_caption,
    theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0))
  )
p

export_plot(
  here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "4D_fmc63_network_averaged_pos_neg"
  ),
  p,
  width = 7,
  height = 4.25
)
```

### Swarmplot with aggregated data

```{r}
tcell_types <- c("CD4 T FMC63-", "CD4 T FMC63+", "CD8 T FMC63-", "CD8 T FMC63+")

# Share of FMC63+ cells among all CD4 / CD8 T cells, per donor and timepoint
cellprop_fmc63_fraction_data <- cellcluster_freq_t0t1_tbl |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(celltype = as.character(celltype)) |>
  filter(celltype %in% tcell_types) |>
  # A donor/timepoint with no cells of a subtype has no row; add it as a 0
  # count (only for donor/timepoint combinations that exist)
  tidyr::complete(
    tidyr::nesting(donor, timepoint),
    celltype = tcell_types,
    fill = list(n_cells = 0)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    lineage = sub(" FMC63[+-]$", "", celltype),
    fmc63_status = sub("^.* ", "", celltype)
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_fmc63_pos = sum(n_cells[fmc63_status == "FMC63+"]),
    n_total = sum(n_cells),
    .by = c(donor, timepoint, lineage)
  ) |>
  # A donor/timepoint is only shown for a lineage (CD4 T or CD8 T) with at least
  # across_donor_min_cells cells of that lineage (set in the pooled Sankey chunk above);
  # below that the fraction is too uncertain (a donor with no cells has no fraction)
  filter(n_total >= across_donor_min_cells) |>
  mutate(
    fmc63_frequency = n_fmc63_pos / n_total,
    lineage = factor(lineage, levels = c("CD4 T", "CD8 T")),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("t0", "t1")),
    # Paired = the donor has data at both timepoints for this lineage
    paired = n_distinct(timepoint) == 2,
    .by = c(donor, lineage)
  )

cellprop_fmc63_swarm_plot <- ggplot(
  cellprop_fmc63_fraction_data,
  aes(x = timepoint, y = fmc63_frequency)
) +
  # outlier.shape = NA: every donor is already drawn as a point below
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_line(
    data = \(d) filter(d, paired),
    aes(group = donor, colour = donor),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.8,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(group = donor, fill = donor),
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.5,
    colour = "black",
    stroke = 0.25
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~lineage) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_donor, labels = \(x) gsub("donor", "", x)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_donor) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0, 1), linewidth = 0.25) +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio = 1.5,
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "FMC63+ cells (% of lineage)",
    title = "FMC63+ cell proportions, t0 vs t1",
    fill = "Donor"
  )
cellprop_fmc63_swarm_plot

export_plot(
  filename = here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "5A_celltype_proportions_tcell_swarm" # Manuscript: Main Figure 5D
  ),
  plot = cellprop_fmc63_swarm_plot,
  width = 4,
  height = 3
)
```

```{r}
  filter(!celltype == "Platelets") |>
  group_by(donor, timepoint, celltype) |>
  summarize(n_cells = n()) |>
  mutate(fraction = n_cells / sum(n_cells)) |>
  mutate(pct = round(fraction, 3) * 100) |>
  mutate(celltype = as.factor(celltype))
```

## 5D: Differential abundance

T1 vs T0 in FMC63+ cells

### Cell-level

```{r}
#| label: fig-5-daa-cd8t

cells_test <- c("CD8 T FMC63+", "CD8 T FMC63-")

n_cell_count <- data_t0t1_b1b2@meta.data |>
  subset(celltype %in% cells_test) |>
  group_by(sample_alias, donor, timepoint, celltype) |>
  summarise(n_cells = n())

donors_exclude <- c("donorD", "donorE") # only PBMC samples - exclude
samples_include <- n_cell_count |> # include only donors/samples with at least min_cells_default cells in both FMC63+/- CD8 T cells
  filter(!donor %in% donors_exclude) |>
  filter(n_cells >= min_cells_default) |>
  group_by(sample_alias, timepoint) |>
  summarize(n = n()) |>
  filter(n == 2) |>
  pull(sample_alias) |>
  unique()

# Not possible to split by donor due to low cell numbers (unless doing pseudobulk)
daa_res <- RunDAA(
  data_t0t1_b1b2 |>
    subset(sample_alias %in% samples_include) |>
    subset(celltype %in% cells_test),
  contrast_column = "timepoint",
  reference = "t0",
  targets = "t1",
  group_vars = c("celltype") # , "donor"
)
daa_res$patient <- "all_donors"
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-5-heatmap
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

daa_res_filtered <- daa_res |>
  filter(marker %in% markers_selected_clr)

# Prepare difference matrix (t1 vs t0)
mat_diff <- daa_res_filtered |>
  select(patient, celltype, marker, difference) |>
  unite("row_id", celltype, patient, sep = " | ") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = difference, values_fill = 0) |>
  column_to_rownames("row_id") |>
  as.matrix()

# Prepare p_adj matrix for annotations
mat_padj <- daa_res_filtered |>
  select(patient, celltype, marker, p_adj) |>
  unite("row_id", celltype, patient, sep = " | ") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = p_adj, values_fill = 1) |>
  column_to_rownames("row_id") |>

# Use if markers should be ordered:

# mat_padj <- mat_padj[, marker_order_fig5, drop = FALSE]

# Ensure matching dimensions and order
mat_padj <- mat_padj[rownames(mat_diff), colnames(mat_diff)]

# Create significance matrix
sig_mat <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(mat_padj), ncol = ncol(mat_padj))
sig_mat[mat_padj < 0.05] <- "*"
sig_mat[mat_padj < 0.01] <- "**"
sig_mat[mat_padj < 0.001] <- "***"

# Define row splits and annotations
row_meta <- data.frame(row_id = rownames(mat_diff)) |>
  separate(
    row_id,

    sep = " \\| ",
    remove = FALSE
  )

# Colors

col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(

row_ann <- rowAnnotation(

    # `Patient` = as.character(pal_donor)
  ),
  show_legend = TRUE,
  annotation_name_side = "top",
  annotation_name_rot = 45,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_diff,
  name = "Difference\n(t1 vs t0)",
  col = col_fun,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = seq(-lims, lims, by = 2), # explicit tick marks
    labels = as.character(seq(-lims, lims, by = 2)),

  ),
  row_split = factor(

  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  width = ncol(mat_diff) * unit(5, "mm"),
  height = nrow(mat_diff) * unit(5, "mm"),
```

### Pseudobulk (unpaired)

Sample-level alternative to the cell-level test above, using the same limma pseudobulk approach as the PNA analyses (`RunPseudobulkDAA()` in `scripts/R/pseudobulk_limma.R`). For each cell type, CLR values are averaged per sample (samples with at least 30 cells of that type), and t1 is compared to t0 across samples with limma, adjusting for batch. A cell type is only tested when it has at least 2 samples at each timepoint. The test is unpaired and includes all donors, so donors D and E (t1 only) contribute t1 samples. Note that t0 samples are CAR T product and t1 samples are PBMC, so the comparison also reflects the change in sample type.

```{r}
#| label: fig-5-daa-pseudobulk

# Minimum cells per sample and cell type for the unpaired pseudobulk tests of
# Fig 5 and Fig 6 (the DAA here and the DCA in Fig 6 use the same values), and
# the minimum number of samples per group (t0 / t1) for a cell type to be tested.
# A cutoff of 30 cells gives a sample mean precise enough for the colocalization
# test (see min_cells_simulation/subsampling/subsampling_notes.md).
pseudobulk_min_cells <- 30
pseudobulk_min_samples_per_group <- 2

daa_pseudobulk <- RunPseudobulkDAA(
  data_t0t1_b1b2,
  contrast_column = "timepoint",
  reference = "t0",
  target = "t1",
  group_col = "celltype",
  sample_col = "sample_alias",
  covariate_cols = "batch",
  min_cells = pseudobulk_min_cells,
  min_samples_per_group = pseudobulk_min_samples_per_group
)

# Samples per cell type used in the tests, and cell types that were skipped
daa_pseudobulk$results |>
  distinct(celltype, n_samples_reference, n_samples_target, covariates)
daa_pseudobulk$skipped

readr::write_csv(
  daa_pseudobulk$results,
  here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "5D_pseudobulk_analysis",
    "5D_daa_pseudobulk_t1_vs_t0.csv"
  )
)
readr::write_csv(
  daa_pseudobulk$sample_means,
  here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "5D_pseudobulk_analysis",
    "5D_daa_pseudobulk_t1_vs_t0_sample_means.csv"
  )
)
```

#### Plot results: heatmap

```{r}
#| label: fig-5-daa-pseudobulk_plot_heatmap

#' Heatmap of pseudobulk differential abundance for one or more cell types
#'
#' One row per cell type, one column per marker; cells show the difference
#' (target - reference) and stars mark FDR-adjusted significance. Draws the
#' heatmap and, if `filename` is given, saves it as PDF and PNG.
#'
#' @param results `results` table from RunPseudobulkDAA().
#' @param cell_types Cell type(s) to show, one row each, in this order.
#' @param markers Markers (columns) to show.
#' @param filename Output path without extension; NULL to only draw.
#' @param cluster_columns Cluster markers (TRUE), or FALSE to keep `markers`
#'   order. Ignored when `column_order` is given.
#' @param column_order Optional marker order to use instead of clustering, e.g.
#'   the `column_order` returned for another cell type, so that several
#'   heatmaps share the same columns.
#' @param split_rows Split rows into one block per cell type, with gaps, as in
#'   the cell-level 5D heatmap. Default: TRUE when more than one cell type.
#' @param lims Colour scale limits (symmetric). NULL: 80% of the largest
#'   absolute difference shown, rounded.
#'
#' @return Invisibly, a list with `heatmap` (the ComplexHeatmap object) and
#'   `column_order` (the marker order as drawn).

plot_pseudobulk_daa_heatmap <- function(
  results,
  cell_types,
  markers = markers_selected,
  filename = NULL,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  column_order = NULL,
  lims = NULL,
  split_rows = length(cell_types) > 1,
  width = 12,
  height = 2.5
) {
  res <- results |>
    filter(celltype %in% cell_types, marker %in% markers)
  missing_types <- setdiff(cell_types, res$celltype)
  if (length(missing_types) > 0) {
    warning(
      "No pseudobulk results for: ",
      paste(missing_types, collapse = ", "),
      " (skipped by RunPseudobulkDAA?)",
      call. = FALSE
    )
    cell_types <- intersect(cell_types, res$celltype)
  }
  if (length(cell_types) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  row_info <- res |>
    distinct(
      celltype,
      n_samples_reference,
      n_samples_target,
      target,
      reference
    ) |>
    mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = cell_types)) |>
    arrange(celltype) |>
    mutate(
      celltype = as.character(celltype),
      row_label = paste0(
        celltype,
        " (n = ",
        n_samples_reference,
        " / ",
        n_samples_target,
        ")"
      )
    )
  contrast_label <- paste0(
    row_info$target[[1]],
    " vs ",
    row_info$reference[[1]]
  )

  to_matrix <- function(value_col) {
    res |>
      select(celltype, marker, all_of(value_col)) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = all_of(value_col)) |>
      column_to_rownames("celltype") |>
      as.matrix()
  }
  mat_diff <- to_matrix("difference")[row_info$celltype, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.null(column_order)) {
    # Shared order from another heatmap: markers not in it go last
    cluster_columns <- FALSE
    column_order <- c(
      intersect(column_order, colnames(mat_diff)),
      setdiff(colnames(mat_diff), column_order)
    )
    mat_diff <- mat_diff[, column_order, drop = FALSE]
  } else if (!isTRUE(cluster_columns)) {
    mat_diff <- mat_diff[, intersect(markers, colnames(mat_diff)), drop = FALSE]
  }
  mat_padj <- to_matrix("p_adj")[
    rownames(mat_diff),
    colnames(mat_diff),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  sig_mat <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(mat_padj), ncol = ncol(mat_padj))
  sig_mat[mat_padj < 0.05] <- "*"
  sig_mat[mat_padj < 0.01] <- "**"
  sig_mat[mat_padj < 0.001] <- "***"

  if (is.null(lims)) {
    lims <- max(1, round(max(abs(mat_diff), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.8, 0))
  }
  col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
    seq(-lims, lims, length.out = 100),
    retro_palette(100)
  )

  row_ann <- rowAnnotation(
    `Cell type` = row_info$celltype,
    col = list(`Cell type` = cell_type_palette_fmc[row_info$celltype]),
    # Legend only when several cell types share the heatmap
    show_legend = length(cell_types) > 1,
    annotation_legend_param = list(`Cell type` = list(at = row_info$celltype)),
    annotation_name_side = "top",
    annotation_name_rot = 45,
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
  )

  ht <- Heatmap(
    mat_diff,
    name = paste0("Difference\n(", contrast_label, ")"),
    col = col_fun,
    heatmap_legend_param = list(legend_height = unit(3, "cm")),
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    row_split = if (isTRUE(split_rows)) {
      factor(row_info$celltype, levels = row_info$celltype)
    } else {
      NULL
    },
    cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
    row_title = NULL,
    row_gap = unit(1.5, "mm"),
    cluster_columns = cluster_columns,
    show_column_dend = isTRUE(cluster_columns),
    row_labels = row_info$row_label,
    row_names_side = "left",
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    left_annotation = row_ann,
    rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    column_names_rot = 45,
    width = ncol(mat_diff) * unit(5, "mm"),
    height = nrow(mat_diff) * unit(5, "mm"),
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      if (sig_mat[i, j] != "") {
        grid.text(
          sig_mat[i, j],
          x,
          y,
          vjust = 0.75,
          gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black")
        )
      }
    },
    column_title = paste0(
      "Differential abundance, pseudobulk\n(",
      contrast_label,
      ", batch-adjusted)"
    ),
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold")
  )

  ht_drawn <- draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
  drawn_order <- colnames(mat_diff)[ComplexHeatmap::column_order(ht_drawn)]

  if (!is.null(filename)) {
    dir.create(dirname(filename), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    pdf(paste0(filename, ".pdf"), width = width, height = height)
    draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
    dev.off()
    png(
      paste0(filename, ".png"),
      width = width,
      height = height,
      units = "in",
      res = png_res
    )
    draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
    dev.off()
  }

  invisible(list(heatmap = ht, column_order = drawn_order))
}

pb_heatmap_dir <- here(
  "mpx_2",
  "results",
  "b1b2_t0t1",
  "revised_figs",
  "5D_pseudobulk_analysis"
)

# File-name-safe cell type label ("CD8 T FMC63+" -> "CD8_T_FMC63pos")
celltype_slug <- function(x) {
  x |>
    gsub(pattern = "\\+", replacement = "pos") |>
    gsub(pattern = "-", replacement = "neg") |>
    gsub(pattern = " ", replacement = "_")
}

# Shared marker order: FMC63+ is clustered, and FMC63- uses the same column
# order so the two heatmaps can be compared column by column. Set
# shared_column_order <- FALSE to cluster each heatmap separately.
shared_column_order <- TRUE
pb_heatmap_cell_types <- c("CD8 T FMC63+", "CD8 T FMC63-")

# markers_plot_hm <- unique(unlist(selected_markers[c(3, 4)]))
# markers_plot_hm <- markers_selected_clr # filtered markers based on clr
markers_plot_hm <- daa_pseudobulk$results |>
  filter(celltype %in% c("CD8 T FMC63-", "CD8 T FMC63+")) |>
  filter(p_adj < 0.05) |>
  pull(marker) |>
  unique()
markers_plot_hm <- intersect(
  markers_plot_hm,
  c(selected_markers$`CD8 T FMC63-`, selected_markers$`CD8 T FMC63+`)
) |>
  unique()

pb_marker_order <- NULL
for (ct in pb_heatmap_cell_types) {
  hm <- plot_pseudobulk_daa_heatmap(
    daa_pseudobulk$results,
    markers = markers_plot_hm,
    cell_types = ct,
    column_order = if (shared_column_order) pb_marker_order else NULL,
    filename = file.path(
      pb_heatmap_dir,
      paste0("5D_daa_heatmap_pseudobulk_", celltype_slug(ct))
    )
  )
  if (shared_column_order && is.null(pb_marker_order) && !is.null(hm)) {
    pb_marker_order <- hm$column_order
  }
}

# Both CD8 T cell types in one heatmap, as in 5D_daa_heatmap_cell_level
plot_pseudobulk_daa_heatmap(
  daa_pseudobulk$results,
  markers = markers_plot_hm,
  cell_types = c("CD8 T FMC63+", "CD8 T FMC63-"),
  filename = file.path(pb_heatmap_dir, "5D_daa_heatmap_pseudobulk_CD8_T"), # Manuscript: Main Figure 5F
  height = 3
)
```

#### Plot results: boxplots

```{r}
#| label: fig-5-daa-pseudobulk_plot_boxplot

# Per-marker boxplots of the sample-level values behind the pseudobulk test:
# mean CLR per sample (samples with >= pseudobulk_min_cells cells of that type), t0 vs t1 for
# each cell type. Points are coloured by donor, and a donor's t0 and t1 samples
# are joined by a line. Points are the raw per-sample means; the stars come
# from the batch-adjusted limma test.
boxplot_cell_types <- c("CD8 T FMC63+", "CD8 T FMC63-")
boxplot_p_cutoff <- 0.05

pb_res_box <- daa_pseudobulk$results |>
  filter(celltype %in% boxplot_cell_types)

# Markers to plot. Default: markers in markers_selected that are significant in
# at least one of the cell types, ordered by the effect in the first cell type.
# To choose markers by hand, overwrite this, e.g.
#   boxplot_markers <- c("CD25", "CD39", "CD44", "FMC63")
boxplot_markers <- pb_res_box |>
  filter(marker %in% markers_selected) |>
  summarise(
    any_sig = any(p_adj < boxplot_p_cutoff),
    effect_first = difference[celltype == boxplot_cell_types[[1]]][1],
    .by = marker
  ) |>
  filter(any_sig) |>
  arrange(desc(effect_first)) |>
  pull(marker)

boxplot_dir <- here(
  "mpx_2",
  "results",
  "b1b2_t0t1",
  "revised_figs",
  "5D_pseudobulk_analysis",
  "boxplots_per_marker"
)

#' Boxplot of per-sample mean CLR for one marker, t0 vs t1 per cell type
plot_pseudobulk_marker_boxplot <- function(
  marker_plot,
  cell_types = boxplot_cell_types,
  sample_means = daa_pseudobulk$sample_means,
  results = pb_res_box
) {
  plot_data <- sample_means |>
    filter(marker == marker_plot, celltype %in% cell_types) |>
    mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = cell_types),
      timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("t0", "t1")),
      donor = sub("_t[0-9]+$", "", sample_alias)
    ) |>
    # Paired = the donor has a sample at both timepoints for this cell type
    mutate(paired = n_distinct(timepoint) == 2, .by = c(donor, celltype))

  stars <- results |>
    filter(marker == marker_plot, celltype %in% cell_types) |>
    mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = cell_types),
      label = case_when(
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      ),
      y = max(plot_data$mean_clr)
    )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_clr)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      outlier.shape = NA,
      width = 0.6,
      linewidth = 0.3,
      colour = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = \(d) filter(d, paired),
      aes(group = donor, colour = donor),
      linewidth = 0.5,
      alpha = 0.8,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = donor),
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.5,
      stroke = 0.25,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    # Star centred between t0 and t1, above the data
    geom_text(
      data = stars,
      aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = -0.6,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~celltype, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal_donor, labels = \(x) gsub("donor", "", x)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_donor) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
    labs(
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = "Mean CLR per sample",
      fill = "Donor",
      title = marker_plot,
      caption = paste0(
        "Pseudobulk, >= ",
        pseudobulk_min_cells,
        " cells per sample;\nbatch-adjusted limma FDR"
      )
    ) +
    theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 1.5,
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
    )
}

# File-name-safe marker label (e.g. "HLA-ABC" stays, spaces/slashes become _)
marker_slug <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9-]", "_", x)

pb_marker_boxplots <- lapply(boxplot_markers, function(m) {
  p <- plot_pseudobulk_marker_boxplot(m)
  export_plot(
    filename = file.path(
      boxplot_dir,
      paste0("5D_daa_boxplot_pseudobulk_CD8_T_", marker_slug(m)) # Manuscript: Main Figure 5G (markers: FMC63, CD278, CD38, CD44, CD49D)
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 4,
    height = 3.5
  )
  p
})
```

### Per donor (cell-level)

```{r}
cells_test <- c("CD8 T FMC63+", "CD8 T FMC63-")

n_cell_count <- data_t0t1_b1b2@meta.data |>
  subset(celltype %in% cells_test) |>
  group_by(sample_alias, donor, timepoint, celltype) |>
  summarise(n_cells = n())

donors_exclude <- c("donorD", "donorE", "donorF", "donorG") # only PBMC samples - exclude
samples_include <- n_cell_count |> # include only donors/samples with at least min_cells_default cells in both FMC63+/- CD8 T cells
  filter(!donor %in% donors_exclude) |>
  filter(n_cells >= min_cells_default) |>
  group_by(sample_alias, timepoint) |>
  summarize(n = n()) |>
  filter(n == 2) |>
  pull(sample_alias) |>
  unique()

# Not possible to split by donor due to low cell numbers (unless doing pseudobulk)
daa_res_donor <- RunDAA(
  data_t0t1_b1b2 |>
    subset(sample_alias %in% samples_include) |>
    subset(celltype %in% cells_test),

daa_res_donor$patient <- daa_res_donor$donor
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

daa_res_filtered <- daa_res_donor |>
  filter(marker %in% markers_selected)

# Prepare difference matrix (t1 vs t0)
mat_diff <- daa_res_filtered |>
  select(patient, celltype, marker, difference) |>
  unite("row_id", celltype, patient, sep = " | ") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = difference, values_fill = 0) |>
  column_to_rownames("row_id") |>
  as.matrix()

# Prepare p_adj matrix for annotations
mat_padj <- daa_res_filtered |>
  select(patient, celltype, marker, p_adj) |>
  unite("row_id", celltype, patient, sep = " | ") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = p_adj, values_fill = 1) |>
  column_to_rownames("row_id") |>
  as.matrix()

# Use if markers should be ordered:
# marker_order_fig5 <- marker_order_mean_abundance[
#   marker_order_mean_abundance %in% colnames(mat_diff)
# ]
# mat_diff <- mat_diff[, marker_order_fig5, drop = FALSE]
# mat_padj <- mat_padj[, marker_order_fig5, drop = FALSE]

# Ensure matching dimensions and order
mat_padj <- mat_padj[rownames(mat_diff), colnames(mat_diff)]

# Create significance matrix
sig_mat <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(mat_padj), ncol = ncol(mat_padj))
sig_mat[mat_padj < 0.05] <- "*"
sig_mat[mat_padj < 0.01] <- "**"
sig_mat[mat_padj < 0.001] <- "***"

# Define row splits and annotations
row_meta <- data.frame(row_id = rownames(mat_diff)) |>
  separate(
    row_id,
    into = c("celltype", "patient"),
    sep = " \\| ",
    remove = FALSE
  )

# Colors
lims <- round(max(abs(mat_diff), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.8, 0)
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  seq(-lims, lims, length.out = 100),
  retro_palette(100)
)

row_ann <- rowAnnotation(
  `Cell type` = row_meta$celltype,
  `Patient` = row_meta$patient,
  col = list(
    `Cell type` = c("CD8 T FMC63+" = "#40097A", "CD8 T FMC63-" = "#AD5BCD"),
    `Patient` = pal_donor
  ),
  show_legend = TRUE,
  annotation_name_side = "top",
  annotation_name_rot = 45,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_diff,
  name = "Difference\n(t1 vs t0)",
  col = col_fun,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = seq(-lims, lims, by = 2), # explicit tick marks
    labels = as.character(seq(-lims, lims, by = 2)),
    legend_height = unit(4, "cm")
  ),
  row_split = factor(
    row_meta$celltype,
    levels = c("CD8 T FMC63+", "CD8 T FMC63-")
  ),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  # cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  left_annotation = row_ann,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  width = ncol(mat_diff) * unit(5, "mm"),
  height = nrow(mat_diff) * unit(5, "mm"),
  row_title = NULL,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (sig_mat[i, j] != "") {
      grid.text(
        sig_mat[i, j],
        x,
        y,
        vjust = 0.75,
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black")
      )
    }
  },
  column_title = "Differential Abundance (t1 vs t0)",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold")
)

draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)

pdf(
  here(
    "mpx_2",

    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "5D_daa_heatmap_donor_level.pdf"
  ),

  height = 3
)
draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()

png(

    "revised_figs",
    "5D_daa_heatmap_donor_level.png"
  ),

  units = "in",
  res = png_res
)
draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
```

### Differential test (pseudobulk)

#### Run differential analysis

```{r}
#| label: fig-6-dpa-pseudobulk_test

# Pseudobulk differential colocalization, t1 vs t0 per cell type (unpaired,
# batch-adjusted limma on per-sample mean pearson_z). See RunPseudobulkDCA()
# in scripts/R/pseudobulk_limma.R.
#
# Filters:
# - dca_min_cells: minimum cells per sample and cell type (same value as for the
#   pseudobulk DAA in Fig 5, set in chunk fig-5-daa-pseudobulk)
# - pseudobulk_min_samples_per_group: minimum samples per group (t0 / t1) for a
#   cell type to be tested (also set in chunk fig-5-daa-pseudobulk)
# - dca_min_mean_clr: a marker is only included for a cell type if its mean CLR
#   is at or above this value in every tested sample of that cell type; pairs are
#   formed from the markers that pass
dca_min_cells <- pseudobulk_min_cells
dca_min_mean_clr <- 0.5

dca_pseudobulk <- RunPseudobulkDCA(
  data_t0t1_b1b2,
  contrast_column = "timepoint",
  reference = "t0",
  target = "t1",
  group_col = "celltype",
  sample_col = "sample_alias",
  covariate_cols = "batch",
  min_cells = dca_min_cells,
  min_mean_clr = dca_min_mean_clr,
  min_samples_per_group = pseudobulk_min_samples_per_group
)

# Samples, markers and pairs tested per cell type, and cell types skipped
dca_pseudobulk$results |>
  summarise(
    n_samples_t0 = first(n_samples_reference),
    n_samples_t1 = first(n_samples_target),
    n_pairs = n(),
    n_significant = sum(p_adj < 0.05),
    .by = celltype
  ) |>
  left_join(
    dca_pseudobulk$markers_tested |> count(celltype, name = "n_markers"),
    by = "celltype"
  )
dca_pseudobulk$skipped

dca_dir <- here(
  "mpx_2",
  "results",
  "b1b2_t0t1",
  "revised_figs",
  "6A_pseudobulk_analysis"
)
dir.create(dca_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

readr::write_csv(
  dca_pseudobulk$results,
  file.path(dca_dir, "6_dca_pseudobulk_t1_vs_t0.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  dca_pseudobulk$sample_means,
  file.path(dca_dir, "6_dca_pseudobulk_t1_vs_t0_sample_means.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  dca_pseudobulk$markers_tested,
  file.path(dca_dir, "6_dca_pseudobulk_t1_vs_t0_markers_tested.csv")
)
```

#### Plot results: boxplots

```{r}
#| label: fig-6-dpa-pseudobulk_plot_boxplots

# Per-pair boxplots of the sample-level values behind the pseudobulk
# colocalization test: mean pearson_z per sample (samples with >= dca_min_cells cells of
# that type), t0 vs t1 for each cell type. Points are coloured by donor, and a
# donor's t0 and t1 samples are joined by a line. Stars come from the
# batch-adjusted limma test (RunPseudobulkDCA()).
coloc_boxplot_cell_types <- c("CD8 T FMC63+", "CD8 T FMC63-")
coloc_boxplot_p_cutoff <- 0.05
coloc_boxplot_min_abs_effect <- 3

dca_res_box <- dca_pseudobulk$results |>
  filter(celltype %in% coloc_boxplot_cell_types)

# Pairs to plot. Default: pairs significant in at least one of the cell types,
# ordered by the effect in the first cell type (largest increase at t1 first).
# A pair is plotted if it is significant AND at least this large in at least one of the
# cell types. Set to 0 to use significance only.
coloc_boxplot_pairs <- dca_res_box |>
  mutate(
    passes = p_adj < coloc_boxplot_p_cutoff &
      abs(difference) >= coloc_boxplot_min_abs_effect
  ) |>
  summarise(
    keep = any(passes),
    # Effect in the first cell type; NA when the pair was not tested there
    # (a marker failed the CLR filter in that cell type)
    effect_first = if (any(celltype == coloc_boxplot_cell_types[[1]])) {
      difference[celltype == coloc_boxplot_cell_types[[1]]]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    # Fallback for ordering: the largest effect among the cell types tested
    effect_any = difference[which.max(abs(difference))],
    .by = pair
  ) |>
  filter(keep) |>
  # Order by the first cell type's effect, falling back to the other cell type
  # for pairs not tested in the first, so no pair drops to the end
  arrange(desc(coalesce(effect_first, effect_any))) |>
  pull(pair)

coloc_boxplot_pairs <- c(coloc_boxplot_pairs, "CD82__FMC63", "CD8__FMC63") |>
  unique()

coloc_boxplot_dir <- here(
  "mpx_2",
  "results",
  "b1b2_t0t1",
  "revised_figs",
  "6A_pseudobulk_analysis",
  "boxplots_per_pair"
)

#' Boxplot of per-sample mean pearson_z for one marker pair, t0 vs t1 per cell type
plot_pseudobulk_pair_boxplot <- function(
  pair_plot,
  cell_types = coloc_boxplot_cell_types,
  sample_means = dca_pseudobulk$sample_means,
  results = dca_res_box
) {
  plot_data <- sample_means |>
    filter(pair == pair_plot, celltype %in% cell_types) |>
    mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = cell_types),
      timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("t0", "t1")),
      donor = sub("_t[0-9]+$", "", sample_alias)
    ) |>
    # Paired = the donor has a sample at both timepoints for this cell type
    mutate(paired = n_distinct(timepoint) == 2, .by = c(donor, celltype))

  # One label per cell type: the FDR star, or "not tested" when the pair was
  # not tested in that cell type (a marker failed the CLR filter there)
  stars <- tibble(celltype = factor(cell_types, levels = cell_types)) |>
    left_join(
      results |>
        filter(pair == pair_plot) |>
        mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = cell_types)) |>
        select(celltype, p_adj),
      by = "celltype"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      label = case_when(
        is.na(p_adj) ~ "not tested",
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      ),
      y = max(plot_data$mean_pearson_z)
    )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_pearson_z)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey70") +
    geom_boxplot(
      outlier.shape = NA,
      width = 0.6,
      linewidth = 0.3,
      colour = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = \(d) filter(d, paired),
      aes(group = donor, colour = donor),
      linewidth = 0.5,
      alpha = 0.8,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = donor),
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.5,
      stroke = 0.25,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    # Label centred between t0 and t1, above the data
    geom_text(
      data = stars,
      aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = -0.6,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~celltype, nrow = 1, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal_donor, labels = \(x) gsub("donor", "", x)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_donor) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
    theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 1.5
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = "Mean pearson_z per sample",
      fill = "Donor",
      title = sub("__", " - ", pair_plot),
      caption = paste0(
        "Pseudobulk, >= ",
        dca_min_cells,
        " cells per sample; batch-adjusted limma FDR"
      )
    )
}

# File-name-safe pair label
pair_slug <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", x)

pb_pair_boxplots <- lapply(coloc_boxplot_pairs, function(pr) {
  p <- plot_pseudobulk_pair_boxplot(pr)
  export_plot(
    filename = file.path(
      coloc_boxplot_dir,
      paste0("6_dca_boxplot_pseudobulk_CD8_T_pair_", pair_slug(pr)) # Manuscript: Main Figure 6F (protein pair "pr": CD45-CD82 and CD49D-CD82)
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 5,
    height = 4
  )
  p
})
names(pb_pair_boxplots) <- coloc_boxplot_pairs

# Show a few in the report; all are saved to coloc_boxplot_dir
patchwork::wrap_plots(head(pb_pair_boxplots, 4), ncol = 2, guides = "collect")
```

### Raw colocalization heatmaps

#### Per sample
from PAT:

```{r}
#| label: colocalization_raw_heatmap_per_cell_type_per_sample

heatmap_grouping_column <- "sample_alias"
max_heatmap_markers <- 30

# Only CD4/CD8 FMC63+/- cells, in a fixed order
cell_types <- c("CD4 T FMC63-", "CD4 T FMC63+", "CD8 T FMC63-", "CD8 T FMC63+")
stopifnot(all(cell_types %in% data_t0t1_b1b2$celltype))

expressed_markers <- unique(unlist(selected_markers[cell_types])) # unique(unlist(markers_to_test))
grouped_marker_abundance <-
  FetchData(
    data_t0t1_b1b2,
    vars = c("celltype", expressed_markers),
    layer = "data"
  ) %>%
  group_by(celltype) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(expressed_markers), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("celltype")

# hm_limits <- c(-1, 1)
hm_limits <- c(-5, 5)

for (cell_type in cell_types) {
  # Optionally limit markers shown in the heatmap to the top most abundant
  plot_markers <-
    grouped_marker_abundance[cell_type, ] %>%
    unlist() %>%
    sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>%
    head(max_heatmap_markers) %>%
    names()

  pg_data_cell_type <- subset(data_t0t1_b1b2, celltype == cell_type)

  proximity_data <- ColocalizationScores(
    # ProximityScores
    pg_data_cell_type,
    lazy = TRUE,
    meta_data_columns = c(heatmap_grouping_column)
  ) |>
    filter(marker_1 %in% plot_markers) |>
    filter(marker_2 %in% plot_markers) |>
    collect()

  summary_proximity_data <- SummarizeProximityScores(
    proximity_data |> rename(join_count_z = pearson_z),
    proximity_metric = "join_count_z",
    group_vars = heatmap_grouping_column
  )
  rm(proximity_data)
  gc()

  # Create reference heatmap to determine marker ordering
  reference_heatmap <- ColocalizationHeatmap(
    summary_proximity_data |>
      group_by(marker_1, marker_2) |>
      summarise(
        mean_join_count_z = mean(mean_join_count_z, na.rm = TRUE),
        pct_detected = mean(pct_detected, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    marker1_col = "marker_1",
    marker2_col = "marker_2",
    value_col = "mean_join_count_z",
    size_col = "pct_detected",
    type = "dots",
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    legend_range = hm_limits
  )

  marker_order <- layer_scales(reference_heatmap)$y$range$range

  # Calculate number of markers for dynamic plot sizing
  n_markers <- length(marker_order)

  # Calculate plot dimensions based on number of markers
  # Base size + scaling factor to ensure readability across different marker counts
  # Minimum size ensures small marker sets are still readable, scaling factor accommodates larger sets
  base_width <- 6
  base_height <- 6
  marker_scaling_factor <- 0.15 # Additional inches per marker
  plot_width <- max(
    base_width,
    base_width + (n_markers - 20) * marker_scaling_factor
  )
  plot_height <- max(
    base_height,
    base_height + (n_markers - 20) * marker_scaling_factor
  )

  # Cap the color scale to c(-1, 1) for consistent and readable heatmaps
  global_value_limits <- hm_limits

  # Calculate global size range across all groups for this cell type
  global_size_range <- range(summary_proximity_data$pct_detected, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Get all unique group values
  unique_groups <- unique(summary_proximity_data[[heatmap_grouping_column]])

  # Create heatmaps for each group using the reference marker order
  # Store plots in a list to combine them later
  group_heatmaps <- list()

  for (group in unique_groups) {
    # Filter data for current group
    group_data <-
      summary_proximity_data |>
      filter(.data[[heatmap_grouping_column]] == group)

    if (
      n_distinct(c(
        group_data$marker_1,
        group_data$marker_2
      )) >=
        2
    ) {
      tmp_plot <- ColocalizationHeatmap(
        group_data,
        marker1_col = "marker_1",
        marker2_col = "marker_2",
        value_col = "mean_join_count_z",
        size_col = "pct_detected",
        type = "dots",
        cluster_cols = FALSE,
        cluster_rows = FALSE,
        legend_range = global_value_limits # Use capped range for consistent scaling
      ) +
        ggtitle(glue::glue(
          "Raw colocalization heatmap for {cell_type} in {group}"
        ))

      # Apply the reference marker order to the ggplot object by modifying the scales
      # This ensures all heatmaps have consistent marker ordering
      tmp_plot <- tmp_plot +
        scale_x_discrete(
          limits = marker_order,
          drop = FALSE,
          position = "top"
        ) +
        scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(marker_order), drop = FALSE)

      # Ensure consistent scales across all groups for fair comparison
      # The legend_range parameter already handles the value scale, but we need to ensure
      # the size scale is also consistent. Try both fill and color aesthetics in case
      # ColocalizationHeatmap uses either one
      plot_layers <- tmp_plot$layers
      has_fill <- any(sapply(plot_layers, function(l) {
        "fill" %in% names(l$mapping) || "fill" %in% names(l$aes_params)
      }))
      has_color <- any(sapply(plot_layers, function(l) {
        "colour" %in%
          names(l$mapping) ||
          "color" %in% names(l$mapping) ||
          "colour" %in% names(l$aes_params)
      }))

      # Apply value scale limits (legend_range should handle this, but ensure it's applied)
      if (has_fill) {
        tmp_plot <- tmp_plot +
          scale_fill_continuous(
            limits = global_value_limits,
            oob = scales::oob_squish
          )
      }
      if (has_color && !has_fill) {
        tmp_plot <- tmp_plot +
          scale_color_continuous(
            limits = global_value_limits,
            oob = scales::oob_squish
          )
      }

      # Ensure consistent size scale across all groups
      tmp_plot <- tmp_plot +
        scale_size_continuous(limits = global_size_range, range = c(0.5, 5))

      # Save individual plot with dimensions scaled to number of markers
      export_plot(
        filename = glue::glue(here::here(
          "mpx_2",
          "results",
          "b1b2_t0t1",
          "revised_figs",
          "6A_raw_colocalization_heatmap_per_cell_type/{cell_type}/{group}_{cell_type}_raw_colocalization_heatmap" # Manuscript: Main Figure 6A (cell type: CD8 T FMC63+. Groups: donorA t0, donorA t1, donorC t0, donorC t1)
        )),
        plot = tmp_plot,
        width = plot_width,
        height = plot_height
      )
    } else {
      # Create an empty plot with a message indicating insufficient markers
      tmp_plot <- ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        geom_text(aes(
          0,
          0,
          label = glue::glue("Insufficient markers in {cell_type} for {group}")
        )) +
        xlim(-1, 1) +
        ylim(-1, 1)
    }

    # Store plot for combined visualization
    group_heatmaps[[group]] <- tmp_plot
  }

  # Create a combined plot with all groups side by side
  n_groups <- length(unique_groups)
  n_rows <- 2
  n_cols <- ceiling(n_groups / n_rows)
  combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(group_heatmaps, nrow = n_rows)

  # Calculate combined plot dimensions: scale width by number of columns, height by number of rows
  # Each subplot maintains its aspect ratio while accommodating multiple groups
  combined_width <- plot_width * n_cols
  combined_height <- plot_height * n_rows

  # Save the combined plot
  export_plot(
    filename = glue::glue(here::here(
      "mpx_2",
      "results",
      "b1b2_t0t1",
      "revised_figs",
      "6A_raw_colocalization_heatmap_per_cell_type/{cell_type}/{cell_type}_all_{heatmap_grouping_column}_raw_colocalization_heatmap"
    )),
    # filename = glue::glue(here::here(
    #   "results/04_proximity/raw_colocalization_heatmap_per_cell_type/{cell_type}/{cell_type}_all_{heatmap_grouping_column}s_combined_raw_colocalization_heatmap"
    # )),
    plot = combined_plot,
    width = combined_width,
    height = combined_height
  )
}
```

#### Per timepoint

```{r}
#| label: colocalization_raw_heatmap_per_cell_type_per_timepoint

# Pseudobulk colocalization per cell type and timepoint:
# mean pearson_z per sample, then averaged across samples per timepoint.
# - coloc_min_cells: minimum cells per sample and cell type
# - coloc_min_mean_clr: a marker is kept for a cell type if its mean CLR is
#   at or above this value in every retained sample of that cell type
coloc_min_cells <- pseudobulk_min_cells # min_cells_default # for comparison with pseudobulk results, use same min cell cutoff
coloc_min_mean_clr <- 0.5
hm_limits <- c(-5, 5)

# Only CD4/CD8 FMC63+/- cells, in a fixed order
cell_types <- c("CD4 T FMC63-", "CD4 T FMC63+", "CD8 T FMC63-", "CD8 T FMC63+")
stopifnot(all(cell_types %in% data_t0t1_b1b2$celltype))

coloc_tp_dir <- here::here(
  "mpx_2",
  "results",
  "b1b2_t0t1",
  "revised_figs",
  "6A_pseudobulk_colocalization_heatmap_per_timepoint"
)
dir.create(coloc_tp_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pb_clr <- pseudobulk_mean_clr(
  subset(data_t0t1_b1b2, celltype %in% cell_types),
  group_col = "celltype",
  sample_col = "sample_alias",
  contrast_column = "timepoint",
  min_cells = coloc_min_cells
)
pb_clr$excluded # sample x cell type combinations below coloc_min_cells

coloc_markers <- pb_clr$sample_means |>
  summarise(min_sample_mean_clr = min(mean_clr), .by = c(celltype, marker)) |>
  filter(min_sample_mean_clr >= coloc_min_mean_clr)

coloc_tp_means <- list()
coloc_marker_orders <- list() # marker order per cell type, reused in later plots
for (cell_type in cell_types) {
  ct_markers <- coloc_markers |> filter(celltype == cell_type) |> pull(marker)
  ct_samples <- pb_clr$sample_means |>
    filter(celltype == cell_type) |>
    distinct(sample_alias, timepoint)

  if (length(ct_markers) < 2 || nrow(ct_samples) == 0) {
    message(cell_type, ": skipped (fewer than 2 markers or no samples)")
    next
  }
  message(
    cell_type,
    ": ",
    length(ct_markers),
    " markers, ",
    nrow(ct_samples),
    " samples"
  )

  # Mean pearson_z per sample and pair; pairs missing in a sample become 0
  sample_coloc <- pseudobulk_mean_coloc(
    subset(data_t0t1_b1b2, celltype == cell_type),
    markers = ct_markers,
    samples = ct_samples$sample_alias,
    sample_col = "sample_alias",
    meta_cols = "timepoint"
  ) |>
    select(
      sample_alias,
      timepoint,
      marker_1,
      marker_2,
      mean_pearson_z,
      pct_detected
    ) |>
    tidyr::complete(
      tidyr::nesting(sample_alias, timepoint),
      tidyr::nesting(marker_1, marker_2),
      fill = list(mean_pearson_z = 0, pct_detected = 0)
    )
  gc()

  # Average the sample means per timepoint
  tp_coloc <- sample_coloc |>
    summarise(
      mean_pearson_z = mean(mean_pearson_z),
      pct_detected = mean(pct_detected),
      n_samples = n(),
      .by = c(timepoint, marker_1, marker_2)
    ) |>
    mutate(celltype = cell_type)
  coloc_tp_means[[cell_type]] <- tp_coloc

  # Marker order from clustering the mean across timepoints
  ref_plot <- ColocalizationHeatmap_custom(
    tp_coloc |>
      summarise(
        mean_pearson_z = mean(mean_pearson_z),
        pct_detected = mean(pct_detected),
        .by = c(marker_1, marker_2)
      ),
    value_col = "mean_pearson_z",
    size_col = "pct_detected",
    type = "dots",
    clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    legend_range = hm_limits
  )
  marker_order <- ggplot2::ggplot_build(ref_plot)$layout$panel_params[[
    1
  ]]$x$get_labels()
  coloc_marker_orders[[cell_type]] <- marker_order

  # Plot size scaled to the number of markers (as in the per-sample chunk)
  n_markers <- length(marker_order)
  plot_size <- max(6, 6 + (n_markers - 20) * 0.15)

  # Shared size scale so dot sizes are comparable across timepoints
  # size_limits <- range(tp_coloc$pct_detected, na.rm = TRUE)
  size_limits <- c(0.25, 1) # manually specify size limits

  timepoints <- sort(unique(tp_coloc$timepoint))
  tp_heatmaps <- list()
  for (tp in timepoints) {
    n_samp <- tp_coloc |>
      filter(timepoint == tp) |>
      pull(n_samples) |>
      first()
    tp_heatmaps[[tp]] <- ColocalizationHeatmap_custom(
      tp_coloc |> filter(timepoint == tp),
      value_col = "mean_pearson_z",
      size_col = "pct_detected",
      marker_order = marker_order,
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      type = "dots",
      legend_range = hm_limits,
      size_range = c(0.5, 4.5)
    ) &
      scale_size(range = c(0.5, 4.5), limits = size_limits) &
      labs(
        title = glue::glue("{cell_type}, {tp} (n = {n_samp} samples)"),
        x = "",
        y = "",
        fill = "Mean\npearson Z\n(of sample mean)",
        size = "Mean fraction\ndetected",
        caption = glue::glue(
          "Averaged colocalization scores per samples and per timepoint.
          Only including samples with >= {coloc_min_cells} cells.
          Markers selected based on abundance CLR >= {coloc_min_mean_clr}."
        )
      )
  }

  p <- patchwork::wrap_plots(tp_heatmaps, nrow = 1)

  export_plot(
    filename = file.path(
      coloc_tp_dir,
      glue::glue("{cell_type}_all_timepoints_pseudobulk_colocalization_heatmap") # Manuscript: Main Figure 6D (cell type: CD8 T FMC63+)
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = plot_size * length(tp_heatmaps),
    height = plot_size
  )
}

coloc_tp_means_bind <- bind_rows(coloc_tp_means)
readr::write_csv(
  coloc_tp_means_bind,
  file.path(coloc_tp_dir, "pseudobulk_colocalization_per_timepoint.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  coloc_markers,
  file.path(coloc_tp_dir, "pseudobulk_colocalization_markers_included.csv")
)
```
