## 6B: FMC63 colocalization

Colocalization scores across donors and timepoints together with abundance for selected markers (abundance taken from previous plot?)

To further investigate marker dynamics between pre-infusion (t0) and post-infusion (t1), the raw colocalization scores (mean pearson Z) for FMC63 pairs are shown below. Rows (markers) are clustered to identify modules with similar behavior and annotated with a dynamics category:

- **shared changes**: Colocalization shifts in the same direction (increase or decrease) across all donors, or both donors exhibit the same sign flip (e.g., negative to positive).
- **donor-specific loss**: Colocalization changes from positive (t0) to negative (t1) in only a subset of donors.
- **donor-specific gain**: Colocalization changes from negative (t0) to positive (t1) in only a subset of donors.
- **mostly unchanged**: The magnitude of change between timepoints is minimal ($\Delta Z \le 0.5$) for the majority of donors.

```{r}
#| label: raw-coloc-scores
cells_test <- c("CD8 T FMC63+")
n_cell_count <- data_t0t1_b1b2@meta.data |>
  subset(celltype %in% cells_test) |>
  group_by(sample_alias, donor, timepoint, celltype) |>
  summarise(n_cells = n())

# donors_exclude <- c("donorD", "donorE")
samples_include <- n_cell_count |> # samples with at least min_cells_default CD8 T FMC63+ cells
  # filter(!donor %in% donors_exclude) |>
  # filter(n_cells >= min_cells_default) |>
  filter(n_cells >= pseudobulk_min_cells) |>
  group_by(sample_alias, timepoint) |>
  pull(sample_alias) |>
  unique()

raw_coloc_fmc63 <- colocscores_summarized_t0t1 |>
  mutate(sample_alias = paste0(donor, "_", timepoint)) |>
  filter(celltype == "CD8 T FMC63+") |>
  # filter(donor != "donor_44") |>
  filter(sample_alias %in% samples_include) |>
  filter(marker_1 == "FMC63" | marker_2 == "FMC63") |>
  mutate(
    marker_non_fmc63 = if_else(marker_1 == "FMC63", marker_2, marker_1)
  ) |>
  filter(marker_non_fmc63 %in% markers_selected)

if (nrow(raw_coloc_fmc63) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No raw FMC63-pair rows found in colocscores_summarized_t0t1 after filtering."
  )
}

raw_coloc_plot <- raw_coloc_fmc63 |>
  select(donor, timepoint, marker_non_fmc63, mean_pearson_z) |>
  group_by(donor, timepoint, marker_non_fmc63) |>
  summarise(
    mean_pearson_z = mean(mean_pearson_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Donor order: donors with paired t0/t1 samples first, then t0 only, then t1 only
# (alphabetical within each group). Based on the samples that pass the cell cutoff.
donor_levels_raw <- raw_coloc_plot |>
  distinct(donor, timepoint) |>
  summarise(
    pairing = case_when(
      all(c("t0", "t1") %in% timepoint) ~ "1_paired",
      "t0" %in% timepoint ~ "2_t0_only",
      TRUE ~ "3_t1_only"
    ),
    .by = donor
  ) |>
  arrange(pairing, donor) |>
  pull(donor)
timepoint_levels_raw <- c("t0", "t1")

raw_coloc_plot <- raw_coloc_plot |>
  filter(donor %in% donor_levels_raw, timepoint %in% timepoint_levels_raw) |>
  mutate(
    donor = factor(donor, levels = donor_levels_raw),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = timepoint_levels_raw),
    col_id = paste(donor, timepoint, sep = "__")
  )

mat_raw_coloc <- raw_coloc_plot |>
  select(marker_non_fmc63, col_id, mean_pearson_z) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = col_id,
    values_from = mean_pearson_z,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  column_to_rownames("marker_non_fmc63") |>
  as.matrix()

ordered_col_ids_raw <- as.vector(outer(
  donor_levels_raw,
  timepoint_levels_raw,
  paste,
  sep = "__"
))
ordered_col_ids_raw <- ordered_col_ids_raw[
  ordered_col_ids_raw %in% colnames(mat_raw_coloc)
]
mat_raw_coloc <- mat_raw_coloc[, ordered_col_ids_raw, drop = FALSE]

col_meta_raw <- tibble(col_id = colnames(mat_raw_coloc)) |>
  separate(
    col_id,
    into = c("donor", "timepoint"),
    sep = "__",
    remove = FALSE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    donor = factor(donor, levels = donor_levels_raw),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = timepoint_levels_raw)
  )

# Gaps between donor slices: small between paired donors, none within the
# t0-only and t1-only groups, larger between the three groups
pairing_raw <- col_meta_raw |>
  summarise(
    pairing = case_when(
      n_distinct(timepoint) == 2 ~ "paired",
      first(timepoint) == "t0" ~ "t0_only",
      TRUE ~ "t1_only"
    ),
    .by = donor
  )
slice_pairing <- pairing_raw$pairing[
  match(levels(droplevels(col_meta_raw$donor)), pairing_raw$donor)
]
n_slices <- length(slice_pairing)
column_gap_mm <- ifelse(
  slice_pairing[-n_slices] != slice_pairing[-1],
  5,
  ifelse(slice_pairing[-1] == "paired", 1, 0)
)

# Row-level dynamics annotation between t0 and t1 on a per-donor basis
change_threshold <- 0.5
row_dynamics <- apply(mat_raw_coloc, 1, function(x) {
  vals <- setNames(as.numeric(x), colnames(mat_raw_coloc))
  deltas <- c()
  n_pairs <- 0
  n_loss <- 0
  n_gain <- 0

  for (d in donor_levels_raw) {
    t0_key <- paste(d, "t0", sep = "__")
    t1_key <- paste(d, "t1", sep = "__")
    if (t0_key %in% names(vals) && t1_key %in% names(vals)) {
      t0_val <- vals[[t0_key]]
      t1_val <- vals[[t1_key]]
      deltas <- c(deltas, t1_val - t0_val)
      n_pairs <- n_pairs + 1

      is_loss <- t0_val > 0 && t1_val < 0
      is_gain <- t0_val < 0 && t1_val > 0
      n_loss <- n_loss + as.integer(is_loss)
      n_gain <- n_gain + as.integer(is_gain)
    }
  }

  if (length(deltas) == 0) {
    return("mostly unchanged")
  }

  mostly_unchanged <- mean(abs(deltas) <= change_threshold) >= 0.67
  shared_up <- mean(deltas >= change_threshold) >= 0.67
  shared_down <- mean(deltas <= -change_threshold) >= 0.67

  shared_loss <- n_pairs > 0 && n_loss == n_pairs
  shared_gain <- n_pairs > 0 && n_gain == n_pairs
  donor_specific_loss <- n_loss > 0 && n_loss < n_pairs
  donor_specific_gain <- n_gain > 0 && n_gain < n_pairs

  # Partial donor sign flips must be labeled donor-specific.
  if (donor_specific_loss && !donor_specific_gain) {
    return("donor-specific loss")
  }
  if (donor_specific_gain && !donor_specific_loss) {
    return("donor-specific gain")
  }
  if (donor_specific_loss && donor_specific_gain) {
    return("shared changes")
  }

  # Shared changes are only assigned when all donors show the same flip behavior,
  # or when directional changes are shared without sign flips.
  if (shared_loss || shared_gain) {
    return("shared changes")
  }
  if ((shared_up || shared_down) && n_loss == 0 && n_gain == 0) {
    return("shared changes")
  }
  if (mostly_unchanged) {
    return("mostly unchanged")
  }
  return("mostly unchanged")
})

row_dyn_df <- data.frame(
  marker = rownames(mat_raw_coloc),
  dynamic = factor(
    row_dynamics,
    levels = c(
      "mostly unchanged",
      "shared changes",
      "donor-specific loss",
      "donor-specific gain"
    )
  )
)

row_ann_raw <- rowAnnotation(
  Pattern = row_dyn_df$dynamic,
  col = list(
    Pattern = c(
      "mostly unchanged" = "#D9D9D9",
      "shared changes" = "#6BAED6",
      "donor-specific loss" = "#F46D43",
      "donor-specific gain" = "#ccd174ff"
    )
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "top"
)

lims_raw_coloc <- 3

col_fun_raw_coloc <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(-lims_raw_coloc, 0, lims_raw_coloc),
  c("#233C62", "white", "#931b58")
)

ht_raw_coloc <- Heatmap(
  mat_raw_coloc,
  name = "Mean\npearson Z",
  col = col_fun_raw_coloc,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_split = col_meta_raw$donor,
  column_gap = unit(column_gap_mm, "mm"),
  column_title_rot = 90,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  column_labels = toupper(as.character(col_meta_raw$timepoint)),
  row_title = NULL,
  width = ncol(mat_raw_coloc) * unit(5, "mm") + unit(sum(column_gap_mm), "mm"),
  height = nrow(mat_raw_coloc) * unit(5, "mm"),
  left_annotation = row_ann_raw,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    legend_height = unit(4, "cm"),
    at = c(-lims_raw_coloc, 0, lims_raw_coloc),
    labels = c(-lims_raw_coloc, 0, lims_raw_coloc)
  )
)

draw(ht_raw_coloc, merge_legend = TRUE)

pdf(
  here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "6B_raw_coloc_heatmap.pdf"
  ),
  width = 6,
  height = 12
)
draw(ht_raw_coloc, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()

png(
  here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "6B_raw_coloc_heatmap.png"
  ),
  width = 6,
  height = 12,
  units = "in",
  res = png_res
)
draw(ht_raw_coloc, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()
```


### CD3-centric network

Colocalization of CD3E with a fixed set of partner markers (FMC63, CD8, CD43, CD11a, CD18, CD45) in CD8 T FMC63+ cells. The partner markers are chosen manually and are not filtered on abundance. Edges show the mean pearson Z per sample (donor and timepoint).


```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
#| label: fig6_c_cd3_network

#' CD3E-centred colocalization network of CD8 T FMC63+ cells, one panel per
#' sample (donor_timepoint). Edges connect CD3E to a fixed, manually chosen set
#' of partner markers (no abundance filter) and show the mean pearson_z of the
#' sample, capped at +/-6. All samples are shown (no minimum cell count).

#' Define markers
marker_focus <- "CD3E"
net_celltype <- "CD8 T FMC63+"
custom_limits <- c(-6, 6)

# Same marker set as the per-timepoint network below
markers_plot <- base::union(
  marker_focus,
  c("FMC63", "CD3E", "CD8", "CD43", "CD11a", "CD18", "CD45")
)
message(net_celltype, ": ", length(markers_plot), " markers plotted")

net_caption <- glue::glue(
  "{net_celltype}. Partner markers: fixed selection, not filtered on abundance. \\
  All samples shown.
  Edge colour: mean Pearson Z per sample (capped at ±6)."
)

#' Prepare data
df_net_cd3 <- colocscores_summarized_t0t1 %>%
  filter(celltype == "CD8 T FMC63+") |>
  filter(marker_1 == marker_focus | marker_2 == marker_focus) |>
  mutate(
    to = ifelse(marker_1 == marker_focus, marker_2, marker_1),
    from = ifelse(marker_2 == marker_focus, marker_2, marker_1)
  ) |>
  filter(to %in% markers_plot) |>
  group_by(to) |>
  # filter(all(abs(mean_pearson_z) > 0.25)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(sample_alias = paste0(donor, "_", timepoint)) |>
  select(to, from, mean_pearson_z, sample_alias, donor, timepoint)


#' Plot graph
df_net_cd3 <- df_net_cd3 |>
  mutate(
    mean_pearson_z_limit = ifelse(
      mean_pearson_z > custom_limits[2],
      custom_limits[2],
      ifelse(
        mean_pearson_z < custom_limits[1],
        custom_limits[1],
        mean_pearson_z
      )
    )
  )

cd3_network_p <- tidygraph::as_tbl_graph(df_net_cd3) %>%
  ggraph(layout = "graphopt") +
  geom_edge_link(aes(color = mean_pearson_z_limit), width = 2) +
  geom_node_label(
    aes(label = name, filter = name == marker_focus),
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3,
    fill = "#FEFCDA",
    label.padding = unit(0.3, "lines")
  ) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name, filter = name != marker_focus), size = 3) +
  facet_edges(~sample_alias) +
  scale_edge_color_gradientn(
    colours = c("#233C62", "white", "#931b58"),
    limits = custom_limits
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CD3E centric network",
    caption = net_caption
  ) +
  coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
    # aspect.ratio = 1,
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.spacing = unit(4, "lines"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14)
  )

cd3_network_p

export_plot(
  here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "6C_cd3_centric_network_per_sample"
  ),
  cd3_network_p,
  width = 8,
  height = 8
)
```


Summarized per timepoint

CD3E network per timepoint, averaged across donors with >= 15 CD8 T FMC63+ cells at that timepoint. Same partner markers as above.

```{r}
#| label: fig6_c_cd3_network_avg_timepoint

#' CD3E-centred colocalization network of CD8 T FMC63+ cells, one network per
#' timepoint, averaged across donors. Edges connect CD3E to the same fixed set
#' of partner markers as the per-sample network above (no abundance filter) and
#' show the mean pearson_z across donors, capped at +/-6. Only donors with
#' >= net_min_cells cells of this cell type at the timepoint are included.
#' Partners are averaged over the donors that have a value (n_donors in the
#' exported table). Node positions are identical in all timepoint panels.

#' Define markers and settings
marker_focus <- "CD3E"
net_celltype <- "CD8 T FMC63+"
net_min_cells <- min_cells_default
custom_limits <- c(-6, 6)

# Same marker set as the per-sample network above
markers_plot <- base::union(
  marker_focus,
  c("FMC63", "CD3E", "CD8", "CD43", "CD11a", "CD18", "CD45")
)
partner_markers <- setdiff(markers_plot, marker_focus)

#' Donors per timepoint with enough cells
donors_keep <- data_t0t1_b1b2[[]] |>
  filter(celltype == net_celltype) |>
  count(donor, timepoint, name = "n_cells") |>
  mutate(included = n_cells >= net_min_cells)
excluded_donors <- donors_keep |> filter(!included)
if (nrow(excluded_donors) > 0) {
  message(
    "Excluded (< ",
    net_min_cells,
    " cells): ",
    paste0(
      excluded_donors$donor,
      "_",
      excluded_donors$timepoint,
      " (",
      excluded_donors$n_cells,
      ")",
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}
donors_keep <- donors_keep |> filter(included)

#' Per-donor edges
df_cd3_per_donor <- colocscores_summarized_t0t1 |>
  filter(celltype == net_celltype) |>
  filter(
    marker_1 == marker_focus | marker_2 == marker_focus,
    marker_1 != marker_2
  ) |>
  mutate(
    to = ifelse(marker_1 == marker_focus, marker_2, marker_1),
    from = marker_focus
  ) |>
  filter(to %in% partner_markers) |>
  semi_join(donors_keep, by = c("donor", "timepoint")) |>
  select(from, to, donor, timepoint, mean_pearson_z)

#' Average across donors per timepoint
df_cd3_avg <- df_cd3_per_donor |>
  summarise(
    n_donors = n_distinct(donor),
    mean_z = mean(mean_pearson_z),
    sd_z = sd(mean_pearson_z),
    .by = c(timepoint, from, to)
  ) |>
  mutate(mean_z_limit = pmin(pmax(mean_z, custom_limits[1]), custom_limits[2]))

n_donors_tp <- donors_keep |> count(timepoint, name = "n_donors")

readr::write_csv(
  df_cd3_avg,
  here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "6C_cd3_network_averaged_per_timepoint.csv"
  )
)

plot_avg_network <- function(edges, title, n_donors) {
  # Fixed node table (same order in every panel) gives identical star layouts
  nodes <- tibble::tibble(name = c(marker_focus, partner_markers))
  graph <- tidygraph::tbl_graph(
    nodes = nodes,
    edges = edges |>
      transmute(
        from = match(from, nodes$name),
        to = match(to, nodes$name),
        mean_z_limit
      )
  )
  ggraph(graph, layout = "star", center = 1) +
    # Fixed limits keep the panel square (star layout uses a unit circle)
    expand_limits(x = c(-1.3, 1.3), y = c(-1.3, 1.3)) +
    geom_edge_link(aes(color = mean_z_limit), width = 3) +
    geom_node_label(
      aes(label = name, filter = name == marker_focus),
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 4,
      fill = "#FEFCDA",
      label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines")
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = name, filter = name != marker_focus),
      size = 4,
      repel = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_edge_color_gradientn(
      colours = c("#233C62", "white", "#931b58"),
      limits = custom_limits,
      name = "Mean\npearson_z"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
    ) +
    coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9)
    )
}

timepoint_titles <- c(t0 = "Pre-infusion (T0)", t1 = "Post-infusion (T1)")
tps <- intersect(c("t0", "t1"), unique(df_cd3_avg$timepoint))
network_tp_plots <- lapply(tps, function(tp) {
  plot_avg_network(
    df_cd3_avg |> filter(timepoint == tp),
    title = paste0(timepoint_titles[[tp]]),
    n_donors = n_donors_tp$n_donors[n_donors_tp$timepoint == tp]
  )
})

avg_caption <- glue::glue(
  "{marker_focus}-centric network in {net_celltype}; mean pearson Z across donors with >= {net_min_cells} cells at each timepoint \\
  ({paste0(n_donors_tp$timepoint, ': ', n_donors_tp$n_donors, collapse = ', ')} donors).
  Partner markers: fixed selection, not filtered on abundance. Edge colour capped at ±6."
)

p <- patchwork::wrap_plots(network_tp_plots, nrow = 1, guides = "collect") +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    caption = avg_caption,
    theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0))
  )
p

export_plot(
  here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "6C_cd3_network_avg_per_timepoint" # Manuscript: Main Figure 6G
  ),
  p,
  width = 2.5 * length(network_tp_plots) + 1,
  height = 4
)
```

```{r}
#' Plot FMC63 abundance and clustering

# Prepare data
polscores_dat <- PolarizationScores(
  data_t0t1_b1b2,
  meta_data_columns = c(
    "sample",
    "sample_alias",
    "donor",

  )
)
polscores_dat$celltype_timepoint <- paste0(
  polscores_dat$celltype,
  "_",
  polscores_dat$timepoint
)

cts <- data_t0t1_b1b2 %>%
  JoinLayers() %>%
  LayerData(layer = "counts") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("marker") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-marker, names_to = "component", values_to = "counts")

polscores_dat <- polscores_dat %>%
  left_join(cts) %>%
  rename(marker_count = counts)

# Filter data based on counts
count_cutoff <- 50
polscores_dat_filt <- polscores_dat %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  filter(marker_count > count_cutoff)

# Prepare plot data
celltypes_plot <- grep(
  "FMC63\\+",
  polscores_dat_filt$celltype |> unique(),
  value = TRUE
)

pol_scores_plot <- polscores_dat_filt |>
  filter(celltype %in% celltypes_plot) |>
  filter(marker_count > 50) |>
  filter(marker == "FMC63") |>
  select(
    morans_z,
    morans_p_adjusted,
    timepoint,
    sample,
    donor,
    celltype_timepoint,
    celltype,
    marker_count,
    component
  ) |>
  mutate(donor_tp = paste0(donor, "_", timepoint)) |>
  mutate(
    timepoint = ifelse(
      timepoint == "t0",
      "Pre-infusion (T0)",
      "Post-infusion (T1)"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    timepoint = factor(
      timepoint,
      levels = c("Pre-infusion (T0)", "Post-infusion (T1)")
    )
  )

# Plot
p <- ggplot(pol_scores_plot, aes(x = donor, y = morans_z)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_quasirandom(

    width = 0.16
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = sample),
    fun = median,
    fun.min = median,
    fun.max = median,
    geom = "crossbar",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.4,
    lwd = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)
  ) +
  facet_grid(~celltype) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_time) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_time) +
  labs(
    y = "FMC63 polarity score\n(Moran's Z)",
    x = "",
    caption = "bar: median value",
    fill = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4)))

export_plot(
  filename = here(
    "mpx_2",
    "results",
    "b1b2_t0t1",
    "revised_figs",
    "S7_fmc63_polarity_donor_timepoint_swarm" # Manuscript: Supplementary Figure 7
  ),
  plot = p,
  width = 5,
  height = 3.5
)
```




# Reviewer responses

## 3-2. FMC63 proximity score-driven separation of cells 

Reviewer comment:
"The analysis of the MPX data is largely limited to averaged pseudo-bulk expression levels. Since the polarization score for each marker, including the CAR, can be calculated at the single-cell level, unsupervised clustering based on these scores could reveal highly informative cellular states. If the current sensitivity of the technology does not support such analyses, the authors should explore computational approaches to maximize the information extracted from the dataset."


### Prepare

```{r}
# Markers with mean CLR >= clr_min_mean across all cells in the object
clr_min_mean <- 0.5

select_clr_markers <- function(obj, min_mean = clr_min_mean) {
  m <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "mpxCells", layer = "data")
  markers <- rownames(m)[Matrix::rowMeans(m) >= min_mean]
  message(length(markers), " markers with mean CLR >= ", min_mean)
  markers
}
```

```{r}
#| label: score-helpers

# Build a cells x features score assay from long-format scores
# (columns: component, feature, value), then return the subsetted object
make_score_object <- function(obj, scores, assay, min_coverage = 0) {
  mat <- scores |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = component, values_from = value) |>
    column_to_rownames("feature") |>
    as.matrix()

  # Keep features scored in >= min_coverage of cells, then cells with no NAs;
  # drop zero-variance features
  mat <- mat[rowMeans(!is.na(mat)) >= min_coverage, , drop = FALSE]
  mat <- mat[, colSums(is.na(mat)) == 0, drop = FALSE]
  mat <- mat[apply(mat, 1, sd) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  message(assay, ": ", nrow(mat), " features x ", ncol(mat), " cells")

  out <- subset(obj, cells = colnames(mat))
  out[[assay]] <- CreateAssayObject(data = mat)
  DefaultAssay(out) <- assay
  VariableFeatures(out) <- rownames(mat)
  out
}

# Scale, PCA and UMAP on the score assay (reductions: pca_<assay>, umap_<assay>)
run_score_dr <- function(obj, assay, dims = 1:5) {
  feats <- rownames(obj[[assay]])
  obj |>
    ScaleData() |>
    RunPCA(
      features = feats,
      npcs = min(15, length(feats) - 1),
      reduction.name = paste0("pca_", assay)
    ) |>
    RunUMAP(
      dims = dims,
      reduction = paste0("pca_", assay),
      reduction.name = paste0("umap_", assay)
    )
}

# UMAP panels: abundance (CLR) on top, score (diverging, centered at 0) below
plot_umap_panels <- function(
  obj,
  assay,
  abund_markers,
  score_feats,
  score_label
) {
  red <- paste0("umap_", assay)

  # Abundance (CLR) lives in the mpxCells assay; FeaturePlot needs the assay key prefix
  abund <- FeaturePlot(
    obj,
    reduction = red,
    features = paste0(Key(obj[["mpxCells"]]), abund_markers),
    order = TRUE,
    combine = FALSE
  ) |>
    purrr::map2(abund_markers, \(p, m) {
      p +
        scale_color_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1, name = "CLR") +
        labs(title = paste(m, "abundance"), x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
        tight
    })

  lim <- max(
    abs(FetchData(obj, vars = score_feats, layer = "data")),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  score <- FeaturePlot(
    obj,
    reduction = red,
    features = score_feats,
    order = TRUE,
    combine = FALSE
  ) |>
    purrr::map2(score_feats, \(p, f) {
      p +
        scale_color_gradient2(
          low = "#2166AC",
          mid = "grey92",
          high = "#B2182B",
          midpoint = 0,
          limits = c(-lim, lim),
          name = score_label
        ) +
        labs(title = f, x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
        tight
    })

  wrap_plots(abund) / wrap_plots(score)
}

# Line plot of the top n positive and negative loading features for one PC, with
# cells ordered by a joint score. highlight: optional feature drawn in black.
# strips: optional named list of strips drawn under the lines, one per metadata
# column: list(label = list(col = "<meta column>", cols = <palette or NULL>)).
# A NULL palette gives a continuous (mako) scale.
plot_pc_lines <- function(
  obj,
  assay,
  pc,
  y_lab,
  noun,
  n_top = 5,
  smooth_k = 25, # rolling-mean window (cells); set to 1 for raw per-cell values
  highlight = NULL,
  strips = NULL
) {
  mat <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(obj, assay = assay, layer = "data"))
  load <- Loadings(obj, reduction = paste0("pca_", assay))[, pc]
  pc_label <- paste0("PC", pc)

  pos <- names(sort(load, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(n_top)]
  neg <- names(sort(load))[seq_len(n_top)]
  draw <- unique(c(pos, neg, highlight))

  # Joint score per cell, so cells are ordered along this PC's axis
  joint <- colMeans(mat[pos, , drop = FALSE]) -
    colMeans(mat[neg, , drop = FALSE])
  cell_order <- names(sort(joint))

  line_data <- mat[draw, cell_order, drop = FALSE] |>
    t() |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(cell_rank = row_number()) |>
    pivot_longer(-cell_rank, names_to = "feature", values_to = "score") |>
    mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = draw)) |>
    group_by(feature) |>
    mutate(
      score = as.numeric(
        stats::filter(score, rep(1 / smooth_k, smooth_k), sides = 2)
      )
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(!is.na(score))

  label_data <- slice_max(line_data, cell_rank, by = feature)
  right_margin <- max(nchar(as.character(label_data$feature))) * 4.5 + 30 # pt
  n_cells <- max(line_data$cell_rank)

  cols <- c(
    setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#B2182B", "#F4A582"))(n_top), pos),
    setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#92C5DE", "#2166AC"))(n_top), neg)
  )
  if (!is.null(highlight)) {
    cols[highlight] <- "black"
  }

  p <- ggplot(line_data, aes(cell_rank, score, color = feature)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = label_data,
      aes(label = feature),
      direction = "y",
      hjust = 0,
      nudge_x = n_cells * 0.04, # fixed gap right of the line ends
      xlim = c((n_cells * 1.01) + 5, Inf), # labels can never go left of the data
      segment.size = 0.3,
      segment.color = "grey50",
      min.segment.length = 0,
      size = 3,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, n_cells), clip = "off") +
    labs(
      x = paste0("Cells ordered by joint ", pc_label, " score"),
      y = y_lab,
      title = paste0("Top ", pc_label, "-separating ", noun)
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(5, right_margin, 5, 5))

  if (is.null(strips)) {
    return(p + theme(legend.position = "none"))
  }

  # One thin strip per metadata column, stacked under the lines in cell order
  strip_plots <- purrr::imap(strips, \(s, lab) {
    d <- tibble(
      cell_rank = seq_along(cell_order),
      value = obj@meta.data[cell_order, s$col]
    )
    ggplot(d, aes(cell_rank, 1, fill = value)) +
      geom_raster() +
      (if (is.null(s$cols)) {
        scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1, name = lab)
      } else {
        scale_fill_manual(values = s$cols, name = lab)
      }) +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, n_cells), clip = "off") +
      labs(y = lab) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(
        axis.title.y = element_text(
          size = 8,
          angle = 0,
          hjust = 1,
          margin = margin(r = 4)
        ),
        plot.margin = margin(0, right_margin, 0, 5),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
  })

  # The x axis moves to the bottom strip
  p <- p +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  last <- length(strip_plots)
  strip_plots[[last]] <- strip_plots[[last]] +
    labs(x = paste0("Cells ordered by joint ", pc_label, " score")) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9))

  wrap_plots(
    c(list(p), strip_plots),
    ncol = 1,
    heights = c(1, rep(0.07, last)),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

# Legends only for the strips under the PC line plots
plot_strip_legends <- function(obj, strips) {
  legends <- purrr::imap(strips, \(s, lab) {
    d <- tibble(value = obj@meta.data[[s$col]])
    p <- ggplot(d, aes(1, 1, fill = value)) +
      geom_raster() +
      (if (is.null(s$cols)) {
        scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1, name = lab)
      } else {
        scale_fill_manual(values = s$cols, name = lab)
      }) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    cowplot::get_plot_component(p, "guide-box-bottom")
  })
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = legends, nrow = 1)
}

# Variance in the first n_pcs PCs explained by technical and biological covariates
# (R2 per PC, plus a PC-variance-weighted overall value).
# - Marginal R2 on all cells: timepoint, donor, batch, log10 UMIs
# - Timepoint | donor: timepoint effect within donor, on donors with >= min_cells
#   cells at every timepoint (0 = any donor present at all timepoints)
# - Donor | batch: donor variation within batch (batch is nested in donor here)
pc_variance_explained <- function(obj, assay, n_pcs = 6, min_cells = 0) {
  red <- paste0("pca_", assay)
  emb <- Embeddings(obj, red)[, seq_len(n_pcs), drop = FALSE]
  md <- obj@meta.data[
    rownames(emb),
    c("timepoint", "donor", "batch", "log10_molecules")
  ]
  pc_var <- Stdev(obj, red)[seq_len(n_pcs)]^2

  multi_tp <- n_distinct(md$timepoint) > 1

  if (multi_tp) {
    paired <- md |>
      count(donor, timepoint) |>
      filter(n >= min_cells) |>
      count(donor) |>
      filter(n == n_distinct(md$timepoint)) |>
      pull(donor)
    message(
      "Paired donors (>= ",
      min_cells,
      " cells per timepoint): ",
      paste(paired, collapse = ", ")
    )
    paired_idx <- md$donor %in% paired
  }

  r2 <- \(y, f, rows = TRUE) {
    summary(lm(f, data = cbind(y = y, md)[rows, ]))$r.squared
  }

  per_pc <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(n_pcs), \(i) {
    y <- emb[, i]
    r2_donor <- r2(y, y ~ donor)
    out <- tibble(
      PC = paste0("PC", i),
      var = pc_var[i],
      Donor = r2_donor,
      Batch = r2(y, y ~ batch),
      `log10 UMIs` = r2(y, y ~ log10_molecules),
      `Donor | batch` = r2_donor - r2(y, y ~ batch)
    )
    if (multi_tp) {
      out$Timepoint <- r2(y, y ~ timepoint)
      out$`Timepoint | donor` <- r2(y, y ~ donor + timepoint, paired_idx) -
        r2(y, y ~ donor, paired_idx)
    }
    out
  })

  list(
    per_pc = per_pc,
    overall = per_pc |>
      summarise(across(-c(PC, var), \(x) weighted.mean(x, var)))
  )
}

plot_variance_explained <- function(res, title) {
  res$per_pc |>
    pivot_longer(-c(PC, var), names_to = "source", values_to = "r2") |>
    mutate(
      source = factor(
        source,
        levels = intersect(
          c(
            "Timepoint",
            "Donor",
            "Batch",
            "log10 UMIs",
            "Timepoint | donor",
            "Donor | batch"
          ),
          unique(source)
        )
      )
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(PC, r2, fill = source)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), width = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Timepoint" = "#E6AB02",
        "Donor" = "grey60",
        "Batch" = "#1B9E77",
        "log10 UMIs" = "#E7298A",
        "Timepoint | donor" = "#7570B3",
        "Donor | batch" = "grey35"
      )
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "R² of PC score", fill = NULL, title = title) +
    theme_classic()
}
```
